statement:
theorem Jn_eq_C_JnQ (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    Indexed.Jn n u v = MvPolynomial.C (JnQ n u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold JnQ Indexed.Jn
  split_ifs with h1 h2 <;> simp [Indexed.cratN]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.algebraMap_Jn
statement:
theorem algebraMap_Jn (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.Jn n u v) = (JnQ n u v) • (1 : RRing n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Jn_eq_C_JnQ, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℚ (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n),
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.algebraMap_cratN
statement:
theorem algebraMap_cratN (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) :
    algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.cratN n q) = q • (1 : RRing n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.cratN
  rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℚ (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n),
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_add
statement:
theorem iota0_add (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (x + y) = iota0 n x + iota0 n y
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [Indexed.indexedMod_add_apply, map_add]
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n)
      ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x b) + algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (y b))
        ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (iota0Basis n b))
    = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n)
        ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x b)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (iota0Basis n b))
      + GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n)
        ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (y b)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (iota0Basis n b))
  rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_smul
statement:
theorem iota0_smul (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) (x : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (c • x) =
      ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n)) * iota0 n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [Indexed.indexedMod_smul_apply, map_mul]
  exact (GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c)
    (⟨algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x b), algebraMap_mem_RGradingQ_zero n (x b)⟩ :
      RGradingQ n 0)
    (iota0Basis n b)).symm

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_eN
statement:
theorem iota0_eN (n : ℕ) (b : Indexed.IndexedBasis n) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.eN b) = iota0AB n b
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0 iota0AB
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · unfold Indexed.eN; simp
  · intro c _ hc
    unfold Indexed.eN
    rw [if_neg hc]
    simp
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_zero_tmul
statement: theorem AB_zero_tmul (n : ℕ) (x : A0 n) : ((0 : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x : AB n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) ((0 : RRing n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x) = 0
  rw [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_zero
statement: theorem iota0_zero (n : ℕ) : iota0 n (0 : Indexed.IndexedMod n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0
  simp only [Indexed.indexedMod_zero_apply, map_zero, AB_zero_tmul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_neg
statement: theorem iota0_neg (n : ℕ) (x : Indexed.IndexedMod n) : iota0 n (-x) = -iota0 n x
proof:
:= by
  have h : iota0 n (-x) + iota0 n x = 0 := by
    rw [← iota0_add, neg_add_cancel, iota0_zero]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_scale
statement:
theorem iota0AB_scale (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) (b : Indexed.IndexedBasis n) :
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n) * iota0AB n b
      = algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (iota0Basis n b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c)
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (RGradingQ n)⟩ : RGradingQ n 0) (iota0Basis n b)]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_smul_eN
statement:
theorem iota0_smul_eN (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) (b : Indexed.IndexedBasis n) :
    iota0 n (c • Indexed.eN b) = algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (iota0Basis n b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_smul, iota0_eN, iota0AB_scale]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_tmul_smul_left
statement:
theorem AB_tmul_smul_left (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (r : RRing n) (x : A0 n) :
    ((c • r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x : AB n) = c • (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) ((c • r) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
      = c • GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
  rw [← map_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn
statement:
theorem algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.cratN n (1/2) * Indexed.Jn n u v)
      = ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n u v) • (1 : RRing n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, algebraMap_cratN, algebraMap_Jn, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_one]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0_tmul_add
statement:
theorem A0_tmul_add (n : ℕ) (x y : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (b : C) :
    ((x + y : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b : A0 n) = x ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b + y ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading ((x + y) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
        + GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading (y ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
  rw [← map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0_tmul_smul
statement:
theorem A0_tmul_smul (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (x : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (b : C) :
    ((c • x : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b : A0 n) = c • (x ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading ((c • x) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
      = c • GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b)
  rw [← map_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.tmul_one_mul_tmul_one
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mul_tmul_one (n : ℕ) (p q : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) :
    (p ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C) : A0 n) * (q ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C) : A0 n) = (p * q) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
    p (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded CGrading⟩ : CGrading 0) (⟨q, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (1 : C)]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0_comm
statement:
theorem L0_comm (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0 n u v * L0 n w z - L0 n w z * L0 n u v
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • L0 n u z + JnQ n u w • L0 n v z
          + JnQ n v z • L0 n u w + JnQ n u z • L0 n v w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L0_eq_tmul, L0_eq_tmul, L0_eq_tmul, L0_eq_tmul, L0_eq_tmul, L0_eq_tmul]
  rw [tmul_one_mul_tmul_one, tmul_one_mul_tmul_one]
  rw [show (L0hat n u v * L0hat n w z : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)
        - (L0hat n w z * L0hat n u v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)
      = (L0hat n u v * L0hat n w z - L0hat n w z * L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C) from by
    change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        ((L0hat n u v * L0hat n w z : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      - GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        ((L0hat n w z * L0hat n u v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        ((L0hat n u v * L0hat n w z - L0hat n w z * L0hat n u v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
            ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
    rw [← map_sub, TensorProduct.sub_tmul]]
  rw [L0hat_comm, A0_tmul_smul, A0_tmul_add, A0_tmul_add, A0_tmul_add,
    A0_tmul_smul, A0_tmul_smul, A0_tmul_smul, A0_tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0Basis_Lof
statement: theorem iota0Basis_Lof (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) : iota0Basis n (Indexed.Lof u v) = L0 n u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.Lof
  split
  · rfl
  · exact (L0_symm n u v).symm

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0Basis_Fof
statement: theorem iota0Basis_Fof (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) : iota0Basis n (Indexed.Fof u) = F0 n u
proof: := rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_tmul_add
statement:
theorem AB_tmul_add (n : ℕ) (r : RRing n) (x y : A0 n) :
    (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x + y) : AB n) = r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x + r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x + y))
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
        + GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)
  rw [← map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_tmul_smul
statement:
theorem AB_tmul_smul (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (r : RRing n) (x : A0 n) :
    (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c • x) : AB n) = c • (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c • x))
      = c • GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
  rw [← map_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_tmul_sub
statement:
theorem AB_tmul_sub (n : ℕ) (r : RRing n) (x y : A0 n) :
    (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x - y) : AB n) = r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x - r ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y
proof:
:= by
  change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x - y))
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x)
        - GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n) (r ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y)
  rw [← map_sub, TensorProduct.tmul_sub]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (n : ℕ) {j : ZMod 2} (a b : A0 n) (ha : a ∈ A0Grading n j) :
    ((1 : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a : AB n) * ((1 : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b) = (1 : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (1 : RRing n) (⟨a, ha⟩ : A0Grading n j)
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (RGradingQ n)⟩ : RGradingQ n 0) b]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_comm_LL
statement:
theorem iota0AB_comm_LL (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u z) + JnQ n u w
          • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof v z)
          + JnQ n v z • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u w) + JnQ n u z • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof v w))
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB
  rw [iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Lof,
      iota0Basis_Lof]
  rw [AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := L0_mem_A0Grading_zero n u v),
    AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := L0_mem_A0Grading_zero n w z), ← AB_tmul_sub, L0_comm,
    AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_add, AB_tmul_add, AB_tmul_add,
    AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_comm_LF
statement:
theorem iota0AB_comm_LF (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) + JnQ n u w
          • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB
  rw [iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Fof, iota0Basis_Fof, iota0Basis_Fof]
  rw [AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := L0_mem_A0Grading_zero n u v),
    AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := F0_mem_A0Grading_one n w), ← AB_tmul_sub, L0_comm_F0,
    AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_add, AB_tmul_smul, AB_tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_comm_FL
statement:
theorem iota0AB_comm_FL (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
      = -((1/2 : ℚ)
          • (JnQ n v w • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) + JnQ n u w • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iota0AB_comm_LF]; abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_anticomm_FF
statement:
theorem iota0AB_anticomm_FF (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v)
        + iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u)
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB
  rw [iota0Basis_Fof, iota0Basis_Fof, iota0Basis_Lof]
  rw [AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := F0_mem_A0Grading_one n u),
    AB_one_tmul_mul_one_tmul (ha := F0_mem_A0Grading_one n v), ← AB_tmul_add, F0_comm_F0,
    AB_tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketLLn_sum
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketLLn_sum (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z)
      = ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n v w) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u z)
        + ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n u w) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof v z)
        + ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n v z) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u w)
        + ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n u z) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof v w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.bracketLLn
  rw [iota0_add, iota0_add, iota0_add,
    iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN,
    algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn, algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn,
    algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn, algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn,
    AB_tmul_smul_left, AB_tmul_smul_left, AB_tmul_smul_left, AB_tmul_smul_left]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketLLn
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketLLn (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z)
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_bracketLLn_sum, iota0AB_comm_LL]; module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketLFn_sum
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketLFn_sum (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w)
      = ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n v w) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u)
        + ((1/2 : ℚ) * JnQ n u w) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.bracketLFn
  rw [iota0_add, iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN,
    algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn, algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn,
    AB_tmul_smul_left, AB_tmul_smul_left]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketLFn
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketLFn (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w)
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_bracketLFn_sum, iota0AB_comm_LF]; module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketFLn
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketFLn (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (-Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w)
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_neg, iota0_bracketLFn]; abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketFFn_sum
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketFFn_sum (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketFFn n u v) = (1/2 : ℚ) • iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.bracketFFn
  rw [iota0_smul_eN, algebraMap_cratN, AB_tmul_smul_left]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketFFn
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketFFn (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketFFn n u v)
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v)
        + iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_bracketFFn_sum, iota0AB_anticomm_FF]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Lof u v) (Indexed.Lof w z))
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof w z) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof]; exact iota0_bracketLLn n u v w z

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Lof u v) (Indexed.Fof w))
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof]; exact iota0_bracketLFn n u v w

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Fof w) (Indexed.Lof u v))
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v)
        - iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof]; exact iota0_bracketFLn n u v w

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Fof u) (Indexed.Fof v))
      = iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v)
        + iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof v) * iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof]; exact iota0_bracketFFn n u v

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_sum
statement:
theorem iota0_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, iota0 n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [iota0_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, iota0_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_sum'
statement:
theorem iota0_sum' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Indexed.Pn n)
    (f : ι → Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i)
      = ∑ i ∈ s, ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (c i)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
          * iota0 n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [iota0_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, iota0_add, iota0_smul, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bracketN
statement:
theorem iota0_bracketN (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (Indexed.bracketN n x y)
      = ∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
          ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x i * y j)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
            * iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n i j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.bracketN
  rw [iota0_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [iota0_sum']

  have := congrFun hxy (i, false)

statement: theorem iotaR_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (x : IndexedMod n) : iotaR x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h heq; apply h; rw [heq]; funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [iotaR]
  · intro h heq; apply h
    have := congrFun heq
    funext i
    have h2 := this (i, false)
    simpa [iotaR] using h2

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaMulR_not_injective
statement:
theorem kappaMulR_not_injective (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (kappaMulR (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  have h0 : ∃ v : Fin (2 * n), True := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨v, -⟩ := h0
  have key : kappaMulR (n := n) (eR (Fof v, true)) = kappaMulR (n := n) (0 : RMod n) := by
    funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩
    cases b with
    | false => simp [kappaMulR]
    | true =>
      have hc : ((i, false) : RBasis n) ≠ (Fof v, true) :=
        fun h => Bool.false_ne_true (congrArg Prod.snd h)
      change eR (Fof v, true) (i, false) = kappaMulR (0 : RMod n) (i, true)
      simp [eR, kappaMulR, hc]
  have := hinj key
  have hne : (eR (n := n) (Fof v, true)) ≠ (0 : RMod n) := by
    intro h
    have := congrFun h (Fof v, true)
    simp [eR] at this
  exact hne this

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_eR_eR
statement:
theorem bracketR_eR_eR (n : ℕ) (p q : RBasis n) :
    bracketR n (eR p) (eR q) = bracketRBasis n p q
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q]
    · simp [eR]
    · intro b _ hb
      have : eR q b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
      simp [this]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ q) h
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eR p b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ p) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_zero_left
statement: theorem bracketR_zero_left (n : ℕ) (y : RMod n) : bracketR n 0 y = 0

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_zero_right
statement: theorem bracketR_zero_right (n : ℕ) (x : RMod n) : bracketR n x 0 = 0

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_add_left
statement:
theorem bracketR_add_left (n : ℕ) (x1 x2 y : RMod n) :
    bracketR n (x1 + x2) y = bracketR n x1 y + bracketR n x2 y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
  simp only [rMod_add_apply]
  rw [add_mul, add_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_add_right
statement:
theorem bracketR_add_right (n : ℕ) (x y1 y2 : RMod n) :
    bracketR n x (y1 + y2) = bracketR n x y1 + bracketR n x y2
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
  simp only [rMod_add_apply]
  rw [mul_add, add_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_smul_left
statement:
theorem bracketR_smul_left (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) (x y : RMod n) :
    bracketR n (c • x) y = c • bracketR n x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
  simp only [rMod_smul_apply, smul_smul]
  congr 1; ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_smul_right
statement:
theorem bracketR_smul_right (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) (x y : RMod n) :
    bracketR n x (c • y) = c • bracketR n x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
  simp only [rMod_smul_apply, smul_smul]
  congr 1; ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_neg_left
statement: theorem bracketR_neg_left (n : ℕ) (x y : RMod n) : bracketR n (-x) y = -bracketR n x y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : bracketR n (-x) y + bracketR n x y = 0 := by
    rw [← bracketR_add_left, neg_add_cancel, bracketR_zero_left]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_bool_eq
statement:
theorem sum_bool_eq {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : Bool → M) :
    ∑ b : Bool, f b = f true + f false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.univ_bool, Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.iotaR_zero
statement: theorem iotaR_zero (n : ℕ) : iotaR (0 : IndexedMod n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [iotaR]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.iotaR_sum_smul
statement:
theorem iotaR_sum_smul {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n) (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    iotaR (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • iotaR (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [iotaR_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, iotaR_add, iotaR_smul, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.iotaR_sum
statement:
theorem iotaR_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    iotaR (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, iotaR (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [iotaR_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, iotaR_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_iotaR_iotaR
statement:
theorem bracketR_iotaR_iotaR (n : ℕ) (x y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketR n (iotaR x) (iotaR y) = iotaR (bracketN n x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR bracketN
  rw [iotaR_sum]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  rw [iotaR_sum_smul, sum_bool_eq]
  have h1 : (∑ j : IndexedBasis n, ∑ b' : Bool,
      (iotaR x (i, true) * iotaR y (j, b')) • bracketRBasis n (i, true) (j, b')) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro b' _
    simp [iotaR]
  rw [h1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
  rw [sum_bool_eq]
  have h2 : (iotaR x (i, false) * iotaR y (j, true)) • bracketRBasis n (i, false)
    (j, true) = 0 := by
    simp [iotaR]
  rw [h2, zero_add]
  simp [iotaR, bracketRBasis]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.zmod2_cases
statement: theorem zmod2_cases : ∀ q : ZMod 2, q = 0 ∨ q = 1
proof: := by decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.gsignN_comm
statement: theorem gsignN_comm (n : ℕ) (a b : ZMod 2) : gsignN n a b = gsignN n b a
proof:
:= by
  unfold gsignN; congr 1; rw [and_comm]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.gsignN_mul_one_left
statement:
theorem gsignN_mul_one_left (n : ℕ) (p q : ZMod 2) :
    gsignN n p 1 * gsignN n p q = gsignN n p (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have e01 : (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1 := by decide
  have e11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  rcases zmod2_cases p with hp | hp <;> rcases zmod2_cases q with hq | hq <;>
    subst hp <;> subst hq <;>
    simp [e01, e11, gsignN_00, gsignN_01, gsignN_10, gsignN_11]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.gsignN_succ_left_mul
statement:
theorem gsignN_succ_left_mul (n : ℕ) (p q : ZMod 2) :
    gsignN n (p + 1) q * gsignN n q 1 = gsignN n p q
proof:
:= by
  have e01 : (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1 := by decide
  have e11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  rcases zmod2_cases p with hp | hp <;> rcases zmod2_cases q with hq | hq <;>
    subst hp <;> subst hq <;>
    simp [e01, e11, gsignN_00, gsignN_01, gsignN_10, gsignN_11]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.parityR_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityR_false {n : ℕ} (i : IndexedBasis n) : parityR ((i, false) : RBasis n)
  = parity i
proof:

  unfold parityR; simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.parityR_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityR_true {n : ℕ} (i : IndexedBasis n) : parityR ((i, true) : RBasis n) =
  parity i + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold parityR; simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketRBasis_super_skew
statement:
theorem bracketRBasis_super_skew (n : ℕ) (p q : RBasis n) :
    bracketRBasis n p q = -(gsignN n (parityR p) (parityR q)) • bracketRBasis n q p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨i, bi⟩; rcases q with ⟨j, bj⟩
  cases bi <;> cases bj <;> simp only [parityR_false, parityR_true, bracketRBasis]
  · 
    rw [bracketBasisN_super_skew i j, iotaR_smul]
  · 
    rw [kappaEmbed_smul, bracketBasisN_super_skew i j, kappaEmbed_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_neg, gsignN_mul_one_left]
  · 
    rw [bracketBasisN_super_skew i j, kappaEmbed_smul, kappaEmbed_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [neg_mul, gsignN_succ_left_mul]
  · 
    simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_super_skew_homog
statement:
theorem bracketR_super_skew_homog (n : ℕ) (x y : RMod n) (dx dy : ZMod 2)
    (hx : IsHomogR x dx) (hy : IsHomogR y dy) :
    bracketR n x y = -(gsignN n dx dy) • bracketR n y x
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : bracketR n y x
      = ∑ i : RBasis n, ∑ j : RBasis n, (x i * y j) • bracketRBasis n j i := by
    unfold bracketR
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    congr 1; ring
  rw [hswap]
  unfold bracketR
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
  by_cases hxy : x i * y j = 0
  · simp [hxy]
  · have hxi : x i ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxy (by rw [h0]; ring)
    have hyj : y j ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxy (by rw [h0]; ring)
    rw [bracketRBasis_super_skew n i j, hx i hxi, hy j hyj, smul_smul, smul_smul, neg_mul]
    congr 1
    ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaR_iotaR
statement: theorem fBetaR_iotaR (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) : fBetaR n (iotaR x) = iotaR (fBetaN n x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaR
  rw [falsePart_iotaR, truePart_iotaR, fBetaN_zero, neg_zero]
  have : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := by funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b
    <;> simp [kappaEmbed]
  rw [this, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaR_kappaEmbed
statement:

    fBetaR n (kappaEmbed x) = -(kappaEmbed (fBetaN n x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaR
  rw [falsePart_kappaEmbed, truePart_kappaEmbed, fBetaN_zero]
  have : iotaR (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := iotaR_zero n
  rw [this, zero_add, kappaEmbed_neg]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaR_add

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaR_smul
statement: theorem fBetaR_smul (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) (r : RMod n) : fBetaR n (c • r) = c • fBetaR n r
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaR
  rw [falsePart_smul, truePart_smul, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul, iotaR_smul, ← neg_smul,
    kappaEmbed_smul, smul_add]
  congr 1
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaEmbed]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.falsePart_neg
statement: theorem falsePart_neg {n : ℕ} (r : RMod n) : falsePart (-r) = -falsePart r

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.truePart_neg
statement: theorem truePart_neg {n : ℕ} (r : RMod n) : truePart (-r) = -truePart r
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [truePart]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaMulR_add
statement:
theorem kappaMulR_add (n : ℕ) (r1 r2 : RMod n) :
    kappaMulR (r1 + r2) = kappaMulR r1 + kappaMulR r2
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaMulR]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaMulR_iotaR
statement: theorem kappaMulR_iotaR (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) : kappaMulR (iotaR x) = kappaEmbed x
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaMulR, iotaR, kappaEmbed]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaMulR_kappaEmbed
statement: theorem kappaMulR_kappaEmbed (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) : kappaMulR (kappaEmbed x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaMulR, kappaEmbed]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_eq
statement: theorem TBeta_eq (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : TBeta n r = r + kappaEmbed (fBetaN n (falsePart r))
proof:
:= by
  unfold TBeta fBetaR
  rw [kappaMulR_add, kappaMulR_iotaR, kappaMulR_kappaEmbed, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBetaInv_eq
statement:
theorem TBetaInv_eq (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : TBetaInv n r = r - kappaEmbed
  (fBetaN n (falsePart r))
proof:
:= by
  unfold TBetaInv fBetaR
  rw [kappaMulR_add, kappaMulR_iotaR, kappaMulR_kappaEmbed, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.falsePart_TBeta
statement: theorem falsePart_TBeta (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : falsePart (TBeta n r) = falsePart r
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_add, falsePart_kappaEmbed, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.falsePart_TBetaInv
statement: theorem falsePart_TBetaInv (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : falsePart (TBetaInv n r) = falsePart r
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBetaInv_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, falsePart_add, falsePart_neg, falsePart_kappaEmbed,
    neg_zero, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBetaInv_TBeta
statement: theorem TBetaInv_TBeta (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : TBetaInv n (TBeta n r) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBetaInv_eq, falsePart_TBeta, TBeta_eq]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_TBetaInv
statement: theorem TBeta_TBetaInv (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : TBeta n (TBetaInv n r) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_TBetaInv, TBetaInv_eq]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_add
statement: theorem TBeta_add (n : ℕ) (r1 r2 : RMod n) : TBeta n (r1 + r2) = TBeta n r1 + TBeta n r2
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, TBeta_eq, TBeta_eq, falsePart_add, fBetaN_add, kappaEmbed_add]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_smul
statement: theorem TBeta_smul (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) (r : RMod n) : TBeta n (c • r) = c • TBeta n r
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, TBeta_eq, falsePart_smul, fBetaN_smul, kappaEmbed_smul, smul_add]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_kappaMulR
statement: theorem TBeta_kappaMulR (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : TBeta n (kappaMulR r) = kappaMulR (TBeta n r)
proof:
:= by
  have hfalse : falsePart (kappaMulR r) = 0 := by funext i; simp [falsePart, kappaMulR]
  rw [TBeta_eq, hfalse, fBetaN_zero]
  have hz : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := by
    funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaEmbed]
  rw [hz, add_zero, TBeta_eq, kappaMulR_add, kappaMulR_kappaEmbed, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.IsHomogR_falsePart
statement:
theorem IsHomogR_falsePart {n : ℕ} {r : RMod n} {d : ZMod 2} (hr : IsHomogR r d) :
    IsHomogN (falsePart r) d
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [← parityR_false]
  exact hr (i, false) (by simpa [falsePart] using hi)

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_isHomogR
statement:
theorem TBeta_isHomogR (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) (d : ZMod 2) (hr : IsHomogR r d) :
    IsHomogR (TBeta n r) d
proof:
:= by
  have hfp : IsHomogN (falsePart r) d := IsHomogR_falsePart hr
  have hfb : IsHomogN (fBetaN n (falsePart r)) (d + 1) := fBetaN_isHomogN n (falsePart r) d hfp
  have e11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  intro p hp
  rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b with
  | false =>
    have h1 : (TBeta n r) (i, false) = r (i, false) := by
      rw [TBeta_eq]; simp [kappaEmbed]
    exact hr (i, false) (by rw [← h1]; exact hp)
  | true =>
    have h1 : (TBeta n r) (i, true) = r (i, true) + fBetaN n (falsePart r) i := by
      rw [TBeta_eq]; simp [kappaEmbed]
    rw [parityR_true]
    by_cases h2 : r (i, true) = 0
    · have h3 : fBetaN n (falsePart r) i ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; apply hp; rw [h1, h2, h0]; ring
      have hpar := hfb i h3
      calc parity i + 1 = (d + 1) + 1 := by rw [hpar]
        _ = d + (1 + 1) := by ring
        _ = d := by rw [e11, add_zero]
    · have hpar := hr (i, true) h2
      rwa [parityR_true] at hpar

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketRBeta_eR_eR
statement:
theorem bracketRBeta_eR_eR (n : ℕ) (p q : RBasis n) :
    bracketRBeta n (eR p) (eR q) = bracketRBetaBasis n p q
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketRBeta
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q]
    · simp [eR]
    · intro b _ hb
      have : eR q b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
      simp [this]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ q) h
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eR p b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ p) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaEmbed_zero
statement: theorem kappaEmbed_zero (n : ℕ) : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨i, b⟩; cases b <;> simp [kappaEmbed]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaEmbed_sum
statement:
theorem kappaEmbed_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    kappaEmbed (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, kappaEmbed (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [kappaEmbed_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, kappaEmbed_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaEmbed_sum_smul
statement:
theorem kappaEmbed_sum_smul {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n)
  (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    kappaEmbed (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • kappaEmbed (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [kappaEmbed_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, kappaEmbed_add, kappaEmbed_smul, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketRBeta_iotaR_iotaR
statement:
theorem bracketRBeta_iotaR_iotaR (n : ℕ) (x y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketRBeta n (iotaR x) (iotaR y) = iotaR (bracketN n x y) + kappaEmbed
      (GammaBetaN n x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hlhs : bracketRBeta n (iotaR x) (iotaR y)
      = ∑ i : IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : IndexedBasis n, (x i * y j) • bracketRBetaBasis n (i, false)
        (j, false) := by
    unfold bracketRBeta
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    rw [sum_bool_eq]
    have h1 : (∑ j : IndexedBasis n, ∑ b' : Bool,
        (iotaR x (i, true) * iotaR y (j, b')) • bracketRBetaBasis n (i, true) (j, b')) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro b' _; simp [iotaR]
    rw [h1, zero_add]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
    rw [sum_bool_eq]
    have h2 : (iotaR x (i, false) * iotaR y (j, true)) • bracketRBetaBasis n (i, false)
      (j, true) = 0 := by
      simp [iotaR]
    rw [h2, zero_add]
    simp [iotaR]
  rw [hlhs]
  unfold bracketRBetaBasis
  simp only [smul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl
    (fun i _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (IndexedBasis n)))
      (f := fun j => (x i * y j) • iotaR (bracketBasisN n i j))
      (g := fun j => (x i * y j) • kappaEmbed (GammaBetaBasis n i j)))]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  unfold bracketN GammaBetaN bilinearExtend
  congr 1
  · symm; rw [iotaR_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [iotaR_sum_smul]
  · symm; rw [kappaEmbed_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [kappaEmbed_sum_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_eR_left
statement:
theorem bracketR_eR_left (n : ℕ) (p : RBasis n) (x : RMod n) :
    bracketR n (eR p) x = ∑ q : RBasis n, x q • bracketRBasis n p q
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _; simp [eR]
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eR p b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ p) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_eR_right
statement:
theorem bracketR_eR_right (n : ℕ) (x : RMod n) (q : RBasis n) :
    bracketR n x (eR q) = ∑ p : RBasis n, x p • bracketRBasis n p q
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketR
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q]
  · simp [eR]
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eR q b = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ q) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.kappaEmbed_eq_sum
statement:
theorem kappaEmbed_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (y : IndexedMod n) :
    kappaEmbed y = ∑ k : IndexedBasis n, y k • eR ((k, true) : RBasis n)
proof:
:= by
  funext p; rcases p with ⟨l, b⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp only [rMod_smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single l]
  · simp [eR, kappaEmbed]
  · intro k _ hk
    have : eR ((k, true) : RBasis n) (l, b) = 0 := by
      unfold eR
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hk (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm)]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ l) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_eN_left_eq_sum
statement:
theorem bracketN_eN_left_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) (y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketN n (eN i) y = ∑ k : IndexedBasis n, y k • bracketBasisN n i k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketN
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _; simp [eN]
  · intro a _ ha
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro k _
    have : eN i a = 0 := by unfold eN; rw [if_neg ha]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_eN_right_eq_sum
statement:
theorem bracketN_eN_right_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (y : IndexedMod n) (j : IndexedBasis n) :
    bracketN n y (eN j) = ∑ k : IndexedBasis n, y k • bracketBasisN n k j
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketN
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp [eN]
  · intro a _ ha
    have : eN j a = 0 := by unfold eN; rw [if_neg ha]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_eR_false_kappaEmbed
statement:
theorem bracketR_eR_false_kappaEmbed (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) (y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketR n (eR ((i, false) : RBasis n)) (kappaEmbed y)
      = kappaEmbed (gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketN n (eN i) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hlhs : bracketR n (eR ((i, false) : RBasis n)) (kappaEmbed y)
      = ∑ k : IndexedBasis n, y k • kappaEmbed (gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketBasisN n i k) := by
    rw [bracketR_eR_left]
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
    rw [sum_bool_eq]
    have h1 : (kappaEmbed y (k, false)) • bracketRBasis n (i, false) (k, false) = 0 := by
      simp [kappaEmbed]
    rw [h1, add_zero]
    change (kappaEmbed y (k, true)) • bracketRBasis n (i, false) (k, true)
      = (y k) • kappaEmbed (gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketBasisN n i k)
    simp [kappaEmbed, bracketRBasis]
  rw [hlhs, bracketN_eN_left_eq_sum, Finset.smul_sum, kappaEmbed_sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
  rw [kappaEmbed_smul, kappaEmbed_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_sum_left'
statement:
theorem bracketR_sum_left' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → RMod n)
    (y : RMod n) : bracketR n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) y = ∑ i ∈ s, bracketR n (f i) y
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketR_zero_left]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketR_add_left, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_sum_right'
statement:
theorem bracketR_sum_right' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → RMod n)
    (x : RMod n) : bracketR n x (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, bracketR n x (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketR_zero_right]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketR_add_right, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_false
statement:
theorem bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_false (n : ℕ) (y : IndexedMod n) (j : IndexedBasis n) :
    bracketR n (kappaEmbed y) (eR ((j, false) : RBasis n)) = kappaEmbed (bracketN n y (eN j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaEmbed_eq_sum, bracketR_sum_left']
  have : ∀ k : IndexedBasis n, bracketR n (y k • eR ((k, true) : RBasis n))
    (eR ((j, false) : RBasis n))
      = y k • kappaEmbed (bracketBasisN n k j) := by
    intro k
    rw [bracketR_smul_left, bracketR_eR_eR]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => this k), bracketN_eN_right_eq_sum, kappaEmbed_sum_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_eR_true_kappaEmbed
statement:
theorem bracketR_eR_true_kappaEmbed (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) (y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketR n (eR ((i, true) : RBasis n)) (kappaEmbed y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaEmbed_eq_sum, bracketR_sum_right']
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro k _
  rw [bracketR_smul_right, bracketR_eR_eR]
  simp [bracketRBasis]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_true
statement:
theorem bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_true (n : ℕ) (y : IndexedMod n) (j : IndexedBasis n) :
    bracketR n (kappaEmbed y) (eR ((j, true) : RBasis n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaEmbed_eq_sum, bracketR_sum_left']
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro k _
  rw [bracketR_smul_left, bracketR_eR_eR]
  simp [bracketRBasis]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_kappaEmbed_kappaEmbed
statement:
theorem bracketR_kappaEmbed_kappaEmbed (n : ℕ) (y1 y2 : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketR n (kappaEmbed y1) (kappaEmbed y2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaEmbed_eq_sum y1 (n := n), bracketR_sum_left']
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro k _
  rw [bracketR_smul_left, bracketR_eR_true_kappaEmbed]
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.falsePart_eR_false
statement:
theorem falsePart_eR_false (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) :
    falsePart ((eR ((i, false) : RBasis n))) = eN i
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold falsePart eR eN
  simp [Prod.ext_iff]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.falsePart_eR_true
statement:
theorem falsePart_eR_true (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) :
    falsePart ((eR ((i, true) : RBasis n))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold falsePart eR
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_eR_false
statement:
theorem TBeta_eR_false (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) :
    TBeta n (eR ((i, false) : RBasis n)) = eR ((i, false) : RBasis n) + kappaEmbed
      (fBetaBasis n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_eR_false, fBetaN_eN]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_eR_true
statement:
theorem TBeta_eR_true (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) :
    TBeta n (eR ((i, true) : RBasis n)) = eR ((i, true) : RBasis n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_eR_true, fBetaN_zero]
  have : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := kappaEmbed_zero n
  rw [this, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.intertwining_basis
statement:
theorem intertwining_basis (n : ℕ) (p q : RBasis n) :
    bracketR n (TBeta n (eR p)) (TBeta n (eR q)) = TBeta n (bracketRBeta n (eR p) (eR q))
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨i, bi⟩; rcases q with ⟨j, bj⟩
  cases bi <;> cases bj
  · 
    rw [TBeta_eR_false, TBeta_eR_false, bracketRBeta_eR_eR]
    show bracketR n (eR ((i, false) : RBasis n) + kappaEmbed (fBetaBasis n i))
        (eR ((j, false) : RBasis n) + kappaEmbed (fBetaBasis n j))
      = TBeta n (bracketRBetaBasis n (i, false) (j, false))
    rw [bracketR_add_left, bracketR_add_right, bracketR_add_right]
    rw [bracketR_eR_eR, bracketR_eR_false_kappaEmbed, bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_false,
        bracketR_kappaEmbed_kappaEmbed, add_zero]
    simp only [bracketRBasis]
    set A := gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketN n (eN i) (fBetaBasis n j) with hA
    set B := bracketN n (fBetaBasis n i) (eN j) with hB
    
    have hfix : TBeta n (kappaEmbed (GammaBetaBasis n i j)) = kappaEmbed
      (GammaBetaBasis n i j) := by
      rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_kappaEmbed, fBetaN_zero, kappaEmbed_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [bracketRBetaBasis]
    rw [TBeta_add, TBeta_eq, falsePart_iotaR, hfix]
    set Z := fBetaN n (bracketBasisN n i j) with hZ
    
    rw [G4 n i j]
    unfold deltaFBasis
    rw [bracketN_eN_eN, fBetaN_eN, fBetaN_eN, ← hB, ← hA, ← hZ]
    
    have key : kappaEmbed A + kappaEmbed B = kappaEmbed Z + kappaEmbed (B + A - Z) := by
      rw [← kappaEmbed_add, ← kappaEmbed_add]
      congr 1
      abel
    calc iotaR (bracketBasisN n i j) + kappaEmbed A + kappaEmbed B
        = iotaR (bracketBasisN n i j) + (kappaEmbed A + kappaEmbed B) := by abel
      _ = iotaR (bracketBasisN n i j) + (kappaEmbed Z + kappaEmbed (B + A - Z)) := by rw [key]
      _ = iotaR (bracketBasisN n i j) + kappaEmbed Z + kappaEmbed (B + A - Z) := by abel
  · 
    rw [TBeta_eR_false, TBeta_eR_true, bracketRBeta_eR_eR]
    show bracketR n (eR ((i, false) : RBasis n) + kappaEmbed (fBetaBasis n i))
      (eR ((j, true) : RBasis n))
      = TBeta n (bracketRBetaBasis n (i, false) (j, true))
    rw [bracketR_add_left, bracketR_eR_eR, bracketR_kappaEmbed_eR_true, add_zero]
    show bracketRBasis n (i, false) (j, true) = TBeta n (bracketRBetaBasis n (i, false) (j, true))
    change kappaEmbed (gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketBasisN n i j)
      = TBeta n (kappaEmbed (gsignN n (parity i) 1 • bracketBasisN n i j))
    rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_kappaEmbed, fBetaN_zero]
    have : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := kappaEmbed_zero n
    rw [this, add_zero]
  · 
    rw [TBeta_eR_true, TBeta_eR_false, bracketRBeta_eR_eR]
    show bracketR n (eR ((i, true) : RBasis n))
      (eR ((j, false) : RBasis n) + kappaEmbed (fBetaBasis n j))
      = TBeta n (bracketRBetaBasis n (i, true) (j, false))
    rw [bracketR_add_right, bracketR_eR_eR, bracketR_eR_true_kappaEmbed, add_zero]
    show bracketRBasis n (i, true) (j, false) = TBeta n (bracketRBetaBasis n (i, true) (j, false))
    change kappaEmbed (bracketBasisN n i j) = TBeta n (kappaEmbed (bracketBasisN n i j))
    rw [TBeta_eq, falsePart_kappaEmbed, fBetaN_zero]
    have : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := kappaEmbed_zero n
    rw [this, add_zero]
  · 
    rw [TBeta_eR_true, TBeta_eR_true, bracketRBeta_eR_eR, bracketR_eR_eR]
    change (0 : RMod n) = TBeta n (0 : RMod n)
    have hfp0 : falsePart (0 : RMod n) = 0 := by funext k; simp [falsePart]
    rw [TBeta_eq, hfp0, fBetaN_zero]
    have : kappaEmbed (0 : IndexedMod n) = (0 : RMod n) := kappaEmbed_zero n
    rw [this, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.eR_decompose
statement: theorem eR_decompose (n : ℕ) (r : RMod n) : r = ∑ p : RBasis n, r p • eR p
proof:
:= by
  funext l
  rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp only [rMod_smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single l]
  · simp [eR]
  · intro k _ hk
    have : eR k l = 0 := by unfold eR; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hk)]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ l) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_zero
statement: theorem TBeta_zero (n : ℕ) : TBeta n (0 : RMod n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfp0 : falsePart (0 : RMod n) = 0 := by funext k; simp [falsePart]
  rw [TBeta_eq, hfp0, fBetaN_zero, kappaEmbed_zero, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_sum'
statement:
theorem TBeta_sum' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n)
  (f : ι → RMod n) :
    TBeta n (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • TBeta n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [TBeta_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, TBeta_add, TBeta_smul, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_sum_left''
statement:
theorem bracketR_sum_left'' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n)
    (f : ι → RMod n) (y : RMod n) :
    bracketR n (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) y = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • bracketR n (f i) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketR_zero_left]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketR_add_left, bracketR_smul_left, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketR_sum_right''
statement:
theorem bracketR_sum_right'' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n)
    (f : ι → RMod n) (x : RMod n) :
    bracketR n x (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • bracketR n x (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketR_zero_right]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketR_add_right, bracketR_smul_right, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.TBeta_sum
statement:
theorem TBeta_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → RMod n) :
    TBeta n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, TBeta n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [TBeta_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, TBeta_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.intertwining
statement:
theorem intertwining (n : ℕ) (x y : RMod n) :
    bracketR n (TBeta n x) (TBeta n y) = TBeta n (bracketRBeta n x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hLHS : bracketR n (TBeta n x) (TBeta n y)
      = ∑ p : RBasis n, ∑ q : RBasis n, (x p * y q) • bracketR n (TBeta n (eR p))
        (TBeta n (eR q)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eR_decompose n x, eR_decompose n y]
    rw [TBeta_sum', TBeta_sum', bracketR_sum_left'']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
    rw [bracketR_sum_right'', Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
    rw [smul_smul]
  have hRHS : TBeta n (bracketRBeta n x y)
      = ∑ p : RBasis n, ∑ q : RBasis n, (x p * y q) • bracketR n (TBeta n (eR p))
        (TBeta n (eR q)) := by
    unfold bracketRBeta
    rw [TBeta_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _
    rw [TBeta_sum']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q _
    rw [← bracketRBeta_eR_eR n p q]
    exact congrArg (fun z => (x p * y q) • z) (intertwining_basis n p q).symm
  rw [hLHS, hRHS]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.comm_mul_right_AB
statement:
theorem comm_mul_right_AB (n : ℕ) (x y z : AB n) :
    x*(y*z) - (y*z)*x = (x*y-y*x)*z + y*(x*z-z*x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.comm_mul_left_AB
statement:
theorem comm_mul_left_AB (n : ℕ) (x y z : AB n) :
    (x*y)*z - z*(x*y) = x*(y*z-z*y) + (x*z-z*x)*y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.symm_comm_symm_AB
statement:
theorem symm_comm_symm_AB (n : ℕ) (a b c d : AB n) (p q r s : ℚ)
    (hac : a * c - c * a = p • (1 : AB n))
    (had : a * d - d * a = q • (1 : AB n))
    (hbc : b * c - c * b = r • (1 : AB n))
    (hbd : b * d - d * b = s • (1 : AB n)) :
    (a*b+b*a)*(c*d+d*c) - (c*d+d*c)*(a*b+b*a)
      = (2:ℚ) • (r • (a*d+d*a) + s • (a*c+c*a) + p • (b*d+d*b) + q • (b*c+c*b))
proof:
:= by
  have hab_cd : a*b*(c*d) - (c*d)*(a*b) = a*(b*(c*d)-(c*d)*b) + (a*(c*d)-(c*d)*a)*b :=
    comm_mul_left_AB n a b (c*d)
  have hbcd : b*(c*d) - (c*d)*b = (b*c-c*b)*d + c*(b*d-d*b) := comm_mul_right_AB n b c d
  have hacd : a*(c*d) - (c*d)*a = (a*c-c*a)*d + c*(a*d-d*a) := comm_mul_right_AB n a c d
  have hba_cd : b*a*(c*d) - (c*d)*(b*a) = b*(a*(c*d)-(c*d)*a) + (b*(c*d)-(c*d)*b)*a :=
    comm_mul_left_AB n b a (c*d)
  have hab_dc : a*b*(d*c) - (d*c)*(a*b) = a*(b*(d*c)-(d*c)*b) + (a*(d*c)-(d*c)*a)*b :=
    comm_mul_left_AB n a b (d*c)
  have hbdc : b*(d*c) - (d*c)*b = (b*d-d*b)*c + d*(b*c-c*b) := comm_mul_right_AB n b d c
  have hadc : a*(d*c) - (d*c)*a = (a*d-d*a)*c + d*(a*c-c*a) := comm_mul_right_AB n a d c
  have hba_dc : b*a*(d*c) - (d*c)*(b*a) = b*(a*(d*c)-(d*c)*a) + (b*(d*c)-(d*c)*b)*a :=
    comm_mul_left_AB n b a (d*c)
  have key : (a*b+b*a)*(c*d+d*c) - (c*d+d*c)*(a*b+b*a)
      = (a*b*(c*d) - (c*d)*(a*b)) + (a*b*(d*c) - (d*c)*(a*b))
        + (b*a*(c*d) - (c*d)*(b*a)) + (b*a*(d*c) - (d*c)*(b*a)) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [key, hab_cd, hab_dc, hba_cd, hba_dc, hacd, hbcd, hadc, hbdc, hac, had, hbc, hbd]
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul, mul_one]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0hatBeta_comm
statement:
theorem L0hatBeta_comm (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0hatBeta n u v * L0hatBeta n w z - L0hatBeta n w z * L0hatBeta n u v
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • L0hatBeta n u z + JnQ n u w • L0hatBeta n v z
          + JnQ n v z • L0hatBeta n u w + JnQ n u z • L0hatBeta n v w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold L0hatBeta
  rw [show (1/4:ℚ) • (bU n u * bU n v + bU n v * bU n u)
      * ((1/4:ℚ) • (bU n w * bU n z + bU n z * bU n w))
        - (1/4:ℚ) • (bU n w * bU n z + bU n z * bU n w)
            * ((1/4:ℚ) • (bU n u * bU n v + bU n v * bU n u))
      = (1/16 : ℚ) • ((bU n u * bU n v + bU n v * bU n u) * (bU n w * bU n z + bU n z * bU n w)
          - (bU n w * bU n z + bU n z * bU n w) * (bU n u * bU n v + bU n v * bU n u)) from by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm]; module]
  rw [symm_comm_symm_AB n (bU n u) (bU n v) (bU n w) (bU n z)
    (JnQ n u w) (JnQ n u z) (JnQ n v w) (JnQ n v z)
    (bU_comm_bU n u w) (bU_comm_bU n u z) (bU_comm_bU n v w) (bU_comm_bU n v z)]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.F0AB_eq_aAB_mul_BuAB
statement:
theorem F0AB_eq_aAB_mul_BuAB (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    F0AB n u = (1/2 : ℚ) • (aAB n * BuAB n u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold F0AB Source.F0
  rw [AB_tmul_smul, aAB_mul_BuAB]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_Fof_eq_F0AB
statement:
theorem iota0AB_Fof_eq_F0AB (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Fof u) = F0AB n u
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB F0AB
  rw [iota0Basis_Fof]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB
statement:
theorem iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    iota0AB n (Indexed.Lof u v) = L0AB n u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold iota0AB L0AB
  rw [iota0Basis_Lof]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.F0hatBeta_bracket_FF
statement:
theorem F0hatBeta_bracket_FF (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    F0hatBeta n u * F0hatBeta n v + F0hatBeta n v * F0hatBeta n u
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Fof u) (Indexed.Fof v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F0hatBeta_eq_F0AB, F0hatBeta_eq_F0AB, iota0_bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof,
    iota0AB_Fof_eq_F0AB, iota0AB_Fof_eq_F0AB]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.BuAB_sandwich_aAB
statement:
theorem BuAB_sandwich_aAB (n : ℕ) (y : Fin (2 * n)) :
    aAB n * BuAB n y * aAB n = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • BuAB n y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, BuAB_comm_aAB, ← mul_assoc, aAB_sq, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.BuAB_mul_BuAB_add_swap
statement:
theorem BuAB_mul_BuAB_add_swap (n : ℕ) (y w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    BuAB n y * BuAB n w + BuAB n w * BuAB n y = (4 : ℚ) • L0AB n y w
proof:
:= by
  unfold L0AB
  rw [BuAB_mul, BuAB_mul, ← AB_tmul_add, Bu0_mul_L0hat_shape, AB_tmul_smul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.D_mul_aBuAB
statement:
theorem D_mul_aBuAB (n : ℕ) (x y w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y) * (aAB n * BuAB n w)
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n x * BuAB n y * BuAB n w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y * (aAB n * BuAB n w)
      = betaKappaAB n x * (aAB n * BuAB n y * aAB n) * BuAB n w from by noncomm_ring,
    BuAB_sandwich_aAB, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.aBuAB_mul_D
statement:
theorem aBuAB_mul_D (n : ℕ) (x y w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (aAB n * BuAB n w) * (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y)
      = -((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n x * BuAB n w * BuAB n y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show aAB n * BuAB n w * (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y)
      = aAB n * (BuAB n w * (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n)) * BuAB n y from by noncomm_ring,
    BuAB_comm_betaKappaAB_mul_aAB,
    show aAB n * (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n w) * BuAB n y
      = (aAB n * betaKappaAB n x) * aAB n * BuAB n w * BuAB n y from by noncomm_ring,
    aAB_mul_betaKappaAB,
    show (-(betaKappaAB n x * aAB n)) * aAB n * BuAB n w * BuAB n y
      = -(betaKappaAB n x * (aAB n * aAB n) * BuAB n w * BuAB n y) from by noncomm_ring,
    aAB_sq]
  rw [show betaKappaAB n x * ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (1 : AB n)) * BuAB n w * BuAB n y
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n x * BuAB n w * BuAB n y) from by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.LF_correction
statement:
theorem LF_correction (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
        * F0AB n w
      - F0AB n w
        * ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * L0AB n v w + betaKappaAB n v * L0AB n u w)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n v * BuAB n w + betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n w * BuAB n v
      = betaKappaAB n u * ((4 : ℚ) • L0AB n v w) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_add, BuAB_mul_BuAB_add_swap]
  have e2 : betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n u * BuAB n w + betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n w * BuAB n u
      = betaKappaAB n v * ((4 : ℚ) • L0AB n u w) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_add, BuAB_mul_BuAB_add_swap]
  rw [F0AB_eq_aAB_mul_BuAB]
  rw [show ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
        * ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (aAB n * BuAB n w))
      - ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (aAB n * BuAB n w))
        * ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
      = (1 / 4 : ℚ) • ((betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u)
            * (aAB n * BuAB n w)
          - (aAB n * BuAB n w)
            * (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u)) from by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm]; module]
  rw [add_mul, mul_add, D_mul_aBuAB, D_mul_aBuAB, aBuAB_mul_D, aBuAB_mul_D]
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n v * BuAB n w)
        + (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n u * BuAB n w)
        - (-((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n w * BuAB n v))
            + -((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n w * BuAB n u)))
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ)
          • (betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n v * BuAB n w + betaKappaAB n u * BuAB n w * BuAB n v)
        + (1 / 2 : ℚ)
            • (betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n u * BuAB n w + betaKappaAB n v * BuAB n w * BuAB n u)
      from by module]
  rw [e1, e2]
  rw [show (1 / 4 : ℚ) • ((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * ((4 : ℚ) • L0AB n v w))
        + (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n v * ((4 : ℚ) • L0AB n u w)))
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * L0AB n v w + betaKappaAB n v * L0AB n u w) from by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]; module]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul
statement:
theorem kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) (a0 : A0 n) :
    kappaAB n * ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a0)
      = (kappa n * algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] a0
proof:
:= by
  unfold kappaAB
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (kappa n) (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (A0Grading n)⟩ : A0Grading n 0)
    (⟨algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c, algebraMap_mem_RGradingQ_zero n c⟩ : RGradingQ n 0) a0]
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_L0
statement:
theorem kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_L0 (n : ℕ) (x y z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    kappaAB n * ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n x)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (L0 n y z))
      = betaKappaAB n x * L0AB n y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul, ← Algebra.commutes]
  unfold betaKappaAB betaKappa L0AB
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n x) * kappa n)
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (A0Grading n)⟩ : A0Grading n 0) (L0 n y z)]
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_gammaLFn
statement:
theorem iota0_gammaLFn (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.gammaLFn n u v w)
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * L0AB n v w + betaKappaAB n v * L0AB n u w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.gammaLFn
  rw [iota0_smul, iota0_add, iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN, iota0Basis_Lof, iota0Basis_Lof]
  rw [show ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.cratN n (1 / 2))) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
      (1 : A0 n) : AB n)
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (1 : AB n) from by
    rw [algebraMap_cratN, AB_tmul_smul_left]
    change (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n)
        ((1 : RRing n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n)) : AB n) = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (1 : AB n)
    rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, GradedTensorProduct.of_one]]
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, mul_smul_comm, mul_add, kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_L0,
    kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_L0]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0hatBeta_bracket_LF
statement:
theorem L0hatBeta_bracket_LF (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0hatBeta n u v * F0hatBeta n w - F0hatBeta n w * L0hatBeta n u v
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Lof u v) (Indexed.Fof w))
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.gammaLFn n u v w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_gammaLFn, iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof, iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB, iota0AB_Fof_eq_F0AB,
    L0hatBeta_eq, F0hatBeta_eq_F0AB]
  rw [show (L0AB n u v
        + (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
      * F0AB n w
      - F0AB n w
        * (L0AB n u v
          + (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
      = (L0AB n u v * F0AB n w - F0AB n w * L0AB n u v)
        + (((1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u))
            * F0AB n w
          - F0AB n w
            * ((1 / 2 : ℚ) •
                (betaKappaAB n u * aAB n * BuAB n v + betaKappaAB n v * aAB n * BuAB n u)))
      from by noncomm_ring]
  rw [LF_correction]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.F0hatBeta_bracket_FL
statement:
theorem F0hatBeta_bracket_FL (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    F0hatBeta n w * L0hatBeta n u v - L0hatBeta n u v * F0hatBeta n w
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Fof w) (Indexed.Lof u v))
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.GammaBetaBasis n (Indexed.Fof w) (Indexed.Lof u v))
proof:
:= by
  have hFL : Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Fof w) (Indexed.Lof u v)
      = -(Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Lof u v) (Indexed.Fof w)) := by
    rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof, Indexed.bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof]
  have hGamma : Indexed.GammaBetaBasis n (Indexed.Fof w) (Indexed.Lof u v)
      = -(Indexed.gammaLFn n u v w) := Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_Fof_Lof n w u v
  rw [hFL, hGamma, iota0_neg, iota0_neg, mul_neg, ← neg_add, ← L0hatBeta_bracket_LF]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.hMap_bracketFFn
statement:
theorem hMap_bracketFFn (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    hMap n (bracketFFn n u v) = -(GammaBetaBasis n (Fof u) (Fof v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketFFn GammaBetaBasis gammaFFn
  rw [hMap_smul, hMap_Lof]
  change cratN n (1/2) • (betaN n u • eN (Fof v) + betaN n v • eN (Fof u))
      = -(-(cratN n (1 / 2) • (betaN n u • eN (Fof v) + betaN n v • eN (Fof u))))
  rw [neg_neg]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.hMap_bracketLFn
statement:
theorem hMap_bracketLFn (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    hMap n (bracketLFn n u v w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketLFn
  rw [hMap_add, hMap_smul, hMap_smul, hMap_Fof, hMap_Fof, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.hMap_bracketLLn
statement:
theorem hMap_bracketLLn (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    hMap n (bracketLLn n u v w z)
      = (cratN n (1/2) * Jn n v w) • (betaN n u • eN (Fof z) + betaN n z • eN (Fof u))
        + (cratN n (1/2) * Jn n u w) • (betaN n v • eN (Fof z) + betaN n z • eN (Fof v))
        + (cratN n (1/2) * Jn n v z) • (betaN n u • eN (Fof w) + betaN n w • eN (Fof u))
        + (cratN n (1/2) * Jn n u z) • (betaN n v • eN (Fof w) + betaN n w • eN (Fof v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketLLn
  rw [hMap_add, hMap_add, hMap_add, hMap_smul, hMap_smul, hMap_smul, hMap_smul,
    hMap_Lof, hMap_Lof, hMap_Lof, hMap_Lof]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.betaKappaAB_mul_aAB_mul_BuAB
statement:
theorem betaKappaAB_mul_aAB_mul_BuAB (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (2 * n)) :
    betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y = (2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n x * F0AB n y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F0AB_eq_aAB_mul_BuAB, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.Corr_eq
statement:
theorem Corr_eq (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (betaKappaAB n x * aAB n * BuAB n y + betaKappaAB n y * aAB n * BuAB n x)
      = betaKappaAB n x * F0AB n y + betaKappaAB n y * F0AB n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [betaKappaAB_mul_aAB_mul_BuAB, betaKappaAB_mul_aAB_mul_BuAB, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_F0
statement:
theorem kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_F0 (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (2 * n)) :
    kappaAB n * ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n x)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (F0 n y))
      = betaKappaAB n x * F0AB n y
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul, ← Algebra.commutes]
  unfold betaKappaAB betaKappa F0AB
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n x) * kappa n)
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (A0Grading n)⟩ : A0Grading n 0) (F0 n y)]
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_hMap_term
statement:
theorem iota0_hMap_term (n : ℕ) (a b c d : Fin (2 * n)) :
    kappaAB n * iota0 n ((Indexed.cratN n (1 / 2) * Indexed.Jn n a b) •
        (Indexed.betaN n c • Indexed.eN (Indexed.Fof d)
          + Indexed.betaN n d • Indexed.eN (Indexed.Fof c)))
      = ((1 / 2 : ℚ) * JnQ n a b) • (betaKappaAB n c * F0AB n d + betaKappaAB n d * F0AB n c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_smul, iota0_add, iota0_smul_eN, iota0_smul_eN, iota0Basis_Fof, iota0Basis_Fof]
  rw [show ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.cratN n (1 / 2) * Indexed.Jn n a b))
        ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n)
      = ((1 / 2 : ℚ) * JnQ n a b) • (1 : AB n) from by
    rw [algebraMap_cratN_half_mul_Jn, AB_tmul_smul_left]
    change ((1 / 2 : ℚ) * JnQ n a b) • (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (RGradingQ n) (A0Grading n)
        ((1 : RRing n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n)) : AB n) = ((1 / 2 : ℚ) * JnQ n a b) • (1 : AB n)
    rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, GradedTensorProduct.of_one]]
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, mul_smul_comm, mul_add, kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_F0,
    kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul_F0]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_hMap_bracketLLn
statement:
theorem iota0_hMap_bracketLLn (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z))
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • (betaKappaAB n u * F0AB n z + betaKappaAB n z * F0AB n u)
          + JnQ n u w • (betaKappaAB n v * F0AB n z + betaKappaAB n z * F0AB n v)
          + JnQ n v z • (betaKappaAB n u * F0AB n w + betaKappaAB n w * F0AB n u)
          + JnQ n u z • (betaKappaAB n v * F0AB n w + betaKappaAB n w * F0AB n v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Indexed.hMap_bracketLLn, iota0_add, iota0_add, iota0_add, mul_add, mul_add, mul_add,
    iota0_hMap_term, iota0_hMap_term, iota0_hMap_term, iota0_hMap_term]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0hatBeta_bracket_LL
statement:
theorem L0hatBeta_bracket_LL (n : ℕ) (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0hatBeta n u v * L0hatBeta n w z - L0hatBeta n w z * L0hatBeta n u v
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n (Indexed.Lof u v) (Indexed.Lof w z))
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [L0hatBeta_comm, iota0_hMap_bracketLLn, iota0_bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof, iota0AB_comm_LL,
    iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB, iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB, iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB, iota0AB_Lof_eq_L0AB,
    L0hatBeta_eq, L0hatBeta_eq, L0hatBeta_eq, L0hatBeta_eq, Corr_eq, Corr_eq, Corr_eq, Corr_eq]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.liftsBracket_eq_bridge
statement:
theorem liftsBracket_eq_bridge (n : ℕ) (i j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n) :
    liftsBracket n i j
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n i j) + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.GammaBetaBasis n i j)
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n i j))
proof:
:= by
  match i, j with
  | .inl ⟨(u, v), huv⟩, .inl ⟨(w, z), hwz⟩ =>
    have h := L0hatBeta_bracket_LL n u v w z
    rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof] at h
    change L0hatBeta n u v * L0hatBeta n w z - L0hatBeta n w z * L0hatBeta n u v
        = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z) + kappaAB n * iota0 n (0 : Indexed.IndexedMod n)
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketLLn n u v w z))
    rw [iota0_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact h
  | .inl ⟨(u, v), huv⟩, .inr w =>
    have h := L0hatBeta_bracket_LF n u v w
    rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof] at h
    change L0hatBeta n u v * F0hatBeta n w - F0hatBeta n w * L0hatBeta n u v
        = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w) + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.gammaLFn n u v w)
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w))
    rw [Indexed.hMap_bracketLFn, iota0_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact h
  | .inr w, .inl ⟨(u, v), huv⟩ =>
    have h := F0hatBeta_bracket_FL n u v w
    rw [Indexed.bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof, Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_Fof_Lof] at h
    change F0hatBeta n w * L0hatBeta n u v - L0hatBeta n u v * F0hatBeta n w
        = iota0 n (-Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w)
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (-Indexed.gammaLFn n u v w)
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (-Indexed.bracketLFn n u v w))
    rw [Indexed.hMap_neg, Indexed.hMap_bracketLFn, neg_zero, iota0_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact h
  | .inr u, .inr v =>
    have h := F0hatBeta_bracket_FF n u v
    change F0hatBeta n u * F0hatBeta n v + F0hatBeta n v * F0hatBeta n u
        = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketFFn n u v)
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.GammaBetaBasis n (Indexed.Fof u) (Indexed.Fof v))
          + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketFFn n u v))
    rw [Indexed.hMap_bracketFFn, iota0_neg, mul_neg, h, Indexed.bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof]
    abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.hMap_sum
statement:
theorem hMap_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    hMap n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, hMap n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [hMap_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, hMap_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.hMap_sum'
statement:
theorem hMap_sum' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → Pn n)
    (f : ι → IndexedMod n) :
    hMap n (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • hMap n (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [hMap_zero]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, hMap_add, hMap_smul, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.hMap_bracketN_eq
statement:
theorem hMap_bracketN_eq (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketN n x y)
      = ∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
          (x i * y j) • Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketBasisN n i j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Indexed.bracketN
  rw [Indexed.hMap_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Indexed.hMap_sum']

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.GammaBetaN_eq_sum
statement:
theorem GammaBetaN_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    Indexed.GammaBetaN n x y
      = ∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
          (x i * y j) • Indexed.GammaBetaBasis n i j
proof: := rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.algebraMap_tmul_comm_kappaAB
statement:
theorem algebraMap_tmul_comm_kappaAB (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) :
    kappaAB n * ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n)
      = ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n) * kappaAB n
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul, ← Algebra.commutes]
  unfold kappaAB
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
    (algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c)
    (⟨kappa n, kappa_mem_RGrading_one n⟩ : RGradingQ n 1) (1 : A0 n)]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.algebraMap_tmul_mul_kappaAB_mul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_tmul_mul_kappaAB_mul (n : ℕ) (c : Indexed.Pn n) (z : AB n) :
    kappaAB n * (((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n) * z)
      = ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) c) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n) * (kappaAB n * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, algebraMap_tmul_comm_kappaAB, mul_assoc]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.iota0_bilinearExtend
statement:
theorem iota0_bilinearExtend (n : ℕ) (F : Indexed.IndexedBasis n → Indexed.IndexedBasis n
    → Indexed.IndexedMod n)
    (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    iota0 n (∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, (x i * y j) • F i j)
      = ∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
          ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x i * y j)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
              * iota0 n (F i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [iota0_sum']

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.liftsBracket_general
statement:
theorem liftsBracket_general (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    ∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
        ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x i * y j)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n)) * liftsBracket n i j
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketN n x y)
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.GammaBetaN n x y)
        + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketN n x y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [iota0_bracketN, GammaBetaN_eq_sum, hMap_bracketN_eq, iota0_bilinearExtend,
    iota0_bilinearExtend]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [algebraMap_tmul_mul_kappaAB_mul, algebraMap_tmul_mul_kappaAB_mul, ← mul_add, ← mul_add,
    ← liftsBracket_eq_bridge]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.liftsBracket_recovery
statement:
theorem liftsBracket_recovery (n : ℕ) (x y : Indexed.IndexedMod n) :
    (∑ i : Indexed.IndexedBasis n, ∑ j : Indexed.IndexedBasis n,
        ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (x i * y j)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n)) * liftsBracket n i j)
      - kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.hMap n (Indexed.bracketN n x y))
      = iota0 n (Indexed.bracketN n x y) + kappaAB n * iota0 n (Indexed.GammaBetaN n x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftsBracket_general]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.betaKappaAB_eq_kappaAB_mul
statement:
theorem betaKappaAB_eq_kappaAB_mul (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    betaKappaAB n u = kappaAB n * ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n u))
      ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold betaKappaAB Source.betaKappa
  rw [Algebra.commutes, ← kappaAB_mul_algebraMap_tmul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0AB_eq_L0hatBeta_sub
statement:
theorem L0AB_eq_L0hatBeta_sub (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0AB n u v = L0hatBeta n u v
      - kappaAB n * (((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n u)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
          * F0hatBeta n v
        + ((algebraMap (Indexed.Pn n) (RRing n) (Indexed.betaN n v)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n))
          * F0hatBeta n u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [L0hatBeta_eq, Corr_eq, F0hatBeta_eq_F0AB, F0hatBeta_eq_F0AB, betaKappaAB_eq_kappaAB_mul,
    betaKappaAB_eq_kappaAB_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.Jn_ne_zero_iff_partner
statement:
theorem Jn_ne_zero_iff_partner (n : ℕ) (t u : Fin (2 * n)) (h : Jn n t u ≠ 0) :
    t = partnerN n u
proof:
:= by
  unfold Jn at h
  split_ifs at h with h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨he, hs⟩ := h1
    apply Fin.ext
    unfold partnerN
    rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (u : ℕ) % 2 = 0 by omega)]
    dsimp only
    omega
  · obtain ⟨he, hs⟩ := h2
    apply Fin.ext
    unfold partnerN
    rw [dif_pos he]
    dsimp only
    omega
  · exact absurd (cratN_zero n) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.contraction_identity
statement:
theorem contraction_identity (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * Jn n t u = betaN n u
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (partnerN n u)]
  · rcases eq_or_ne ((u : ℕ) % 2) 0 with hu | hu
    · have e1 : partnerN n u = ⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ := by
        unfold partnerN; rw [dif_pos hu]
      rw [e1]
      have hv : vN n (⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) = -betaN n u := by
        have hp : partnerN n (⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) = u := by
          apply Fin.ext
          unfold partnerN
          rw [dif_neg
            (show ¬ ((⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) % 2 = 0 by
            dsimp only; omega)]
          dsimp only; omega
        unfold vN
        rw [if_neg (show ¬ ((⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) % 2 = 0 by
          dsimp only; omega), hp]
      have hj : Jn n (⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) u = -1 := by
        unfold Jn
        rw [if_neg (by dsimp only; omega),
            if_pos (show (u : ℕ) % 2 = 0 ∧
              ((⟨(u : ℕ) + 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ)
                = (u : ℕ) + 1 from ⟨hu, by dsimp only⟩)]
        rw [show (-1 : ℚ) = -(1 : ℚ) from rfl, ← cratN_neg, cratN_one]
      rw [hv, hj]
      ring
    · have e1 : partnerN n u = ⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ := by
        unfold partnerN; rw [dif_neg hu]
      rw [e1]
      have hv : vN n (⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) = betaN n u := by
