        have hp : partnerN n (⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) = u := by
          apply Fin.ext
          unfold partnerN
          rw [dif_pos (show ((⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) % 2 = 0 by
            dsimp only; omega)]
          dsimp only; omega
        unfold vN
        rw [if_pos (show ((⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) % 2 = 0 by
          dsimp only; omega), hp]
      have hj : Jn n (⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) u = 1 := by
        unfold Jn
        rw [if_pos (show ((⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) % 2 = 0
              ∧ (u : ℕ) = ((⟨(u : ℕ) - 1, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) + 1 from
              ⟨by dsimp only; omega, by dsimp only; omega⟩)]
        exact cratN_one n
      rw [hv, hj]
      ring
  · intro t _ ht
    have : Jn n t u = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact ht (Jn_ne_zero_iff_partner n t u hne)
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.contraction_identity_neg
statement:
theorem contraction_identity_neg (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * Jn n u t = -betaN n u
proof:
:= by
  have heq : ∀ t, vN n t * Jn n u t = -(vN n t * Jn n t u) := by
    intro t
    rw [Jn_antisymm n t u]
    ring
  simp_rw [heq]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, contraction_identity]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_split_even_odd
statement:
theorem sum_split_even_odd {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (g : Fin (2 * n) → M) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), g t
      = ∑ j : Fin n, (g (evenIdx n j) + g (oddIdx n j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (pairEquivN n) g]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  congr 2
  · apply Fin.ext; simp [pairEquivN, finProdFinEquiv, finCongr, evenIdx]
  · apply Fin.ext; simp [pairEquivN, finProdFinEquiv, finCongr, oddIdx]; omega

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaBasis_alt_form
statement:
theorem fBetaBasis_alt_form (n : ℕ) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    fBetaBasis n (Fof u) = -∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t u)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ j : Fin n,
      (betaN n (evenIdx n j) • eN (Lof (oddIdx n j) u) - betaN n (oddIdx n j) • eN
        (Lof (evenIdx n j) u)))
    = -∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t u)
  rw [sum_split_even_odd n (fun t => vN n t • eN (Lof t u))]
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hve : vN n (evenIdx n j) = betaN n (oddIdx n j) := by
    have he : (evenIdx n j : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by unfold evenIdx; dsimp only; omega
    have hp : partnerN n (evenIdx n j) = oddIdx n j := by
      apply Fin.ext; unfold partnerN; rw [dif_pos he]; unfold evenIdx oddIdx; dsimp only
    unfold vN
    rw [if_pos he, hp]
  have hvo : vN n (oddIdx n j) = -betaN n (evenIdx n j) := by
    have ho : ¬ (oddIdx n j : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by unfold oddIdx; dsimp only; omega
    have hp : partnerN n (oddIdx n j) = evenIdx n j := by
      apply Fin.ext; unfold partnerN; rw [dif_neg ho]; unfold evenIdx oddIdx; dsimp only; omega
    unfold vN
    rw [if_neg ho, hp]
  rw [hve, hvo]
  simp only [neg_smul]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaBasis_degree
statement:
theorem fBetaBasis_degree (n : ℕ) (i k : IndexedBasis n) (h : fBetaBasis n i k ≠ 0) :
    parity k = parity i + 1
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | .inl _ => simp [fBetaBasis] at h
  | .inr u =>
    match k with
    | .inl _ => simp only [parity]; decide
    | .inr m => exfalso; apply h; simp [fBetaBasis]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_eN
statement: theorem fBetaN_eN (n : ℕ) (i : IndexedBasis n) : fBetaN n (eN i) = fBetaBasis n i
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaN
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [eN]
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eN i b = 0 := by unfold eN; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_add
statement:
theorem fBetaN_add (n : ℕ) (x1 x2 : IndexedMod n) :
    fBetaN n (x1 + x2) = fBetaN n x1 + fBetaN n x2
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaN
  funext k
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_smul
statement:
theorem fBetaN_smul (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) (x : IndexedMod n) :
    fBetaN n (c • x) = c • fBetaN n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaN
  funext k
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_zero
statement: theorem fBetaN_zero (n : ℕ) : fBetaN n (0 : IndexedMod n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold fBetaN; simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_neg
statement: theorem fBetaN_neg (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) : fBetaN n (-x) = -fBetaN n x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : fBetaN n (-x) + fBetaN n x = 0 := by
    rw [← fBetaN_add, neg_add_cancel, fBetaN_zero]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaBasis_Lof
statement: theorem fBetaBasis_Lof (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin (2 * n)) : fBetaBasis n (Lof a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a b with hab | hab
  · subst hab; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl a)]; rfl
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hgt
    · rw [Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
    · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]; rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_Lof
statement: theorem fBetaN_Lof (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin (2 * n)) : fBetaN n (eN (Lof a b)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_Lof]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.fBetaN_isHomogN
statement:
theorem fBetaN_isHomogN (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) (dx : ZMod 2) (hx : IsHomogN x dx) :
    IsHomogN (fBetaN n x) (dx + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  by_contra hne
  apply hk
  unfold fBetaN
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i _
  by_cases hxi : x i = 0
  · simp [hxi]
  · have hpi := hx i hxi
    have hz : fBetaBasis n i k = 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      exact hne (by rw [fBetaBasis_degree n i k hc, hpi])
    simp [hz]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bilinearExtend_eN_eN
statement:
theorem bilinearExtend_eN_eN {n : ℕ} (F : IndexedBasis n → IndexedBasis n → IndexedMod n)
    (X Y : IndexedBasis n) : bilinearExtend F (eN X) (eN Y) = F X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bilinearExtend
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single X]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single Y]
    · simp [eN]
    · intro b _ hb
      have : eN Y b = 0 := by unfold eN; rw [if_neg hb]
      simp [this]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ Y) h
  · intro b _ hb
    have : eN X b = 0 := by unfold eN; rw [if_neg hb]
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ X) h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_zero_left
statement: theorem bracketN_zero_left (n : ℕ) (y : IndexedMod n) : bracketN n 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketN; simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_zero_right
statement: theorem bracketN_zero_right (n : ℕ) (x : IndexedMod n) : bracketN n x 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracketN; simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_neg_left
statement: theorem bracketN_neg_left {n : ℕ} (x y : IndexedMod n) : bracketN n (-x) y = -bracketN n x y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : bracketN n (-x) y + bracketN n x y = 0 := by
    rw [← bracketN_add_left, neg_add_cancel, bracketN_zero_left]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_sum_right'
statement:
theorem bracketN_sum_right' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → IndexedMod n)
    (x : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketN n x (∑ j ∈ s, f j) = ∑ j ∈ s, bracketN n x (f j)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketN_zero_right]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketN_add_right, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.bracketN_sum_left'
statement:
theorem bracketN_sum_left' {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → IndexedMod n)
    (y : IndexedMod n) :
    bracketN n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) y = ∑ i ∈ s, bracketN n (f i) y
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [bracketN_zero_left]
  | @insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, bracketN_add_left, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_degree0
statement:
theorem GammaBetaBasis_degree0 {n : ℕ} (i j k : IndexedBasis n)
    (h : GammaBetaBasis n i j k ≠ 0) : parity k = parity i + parity j + 1
proof:
:= by
  match i, j with
  | .inl ⟨(_, _), _⟩, .inl ⟨(_, _), _⟩ => simp [GammaBetaBasis] at h
  | .inl ⟨(_, _), _⟩, .inr _ =>
    match k with
    | .inr _ => exfalso; apply h; simp [GammaBetaBasis, gammaLFn, eN_Lof_apply_inr]
    | .inl _ => simp only [parity]; decide
  | .inr _, .inl ⟨(_, _), _⟩ =>
    match k with
    | .inr _ => exfalso; apply h; simp [GammaBetaBasis, gammaLFn, eN_Lof_apply_inr]
    | .inl _ => simp only [parity]; decide
  | .inr _, .inr _ =>
    match k with
    | .inl _ => exfalso; apply h; simp [GammaBetaBasis, gammaFFn, Fof, eN]
    | .inr _ => simp only [parity]; decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Lof
statement:
theorem GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Lof (n : ℕ) (a b c d : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Lof a b) (Lof c d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a b with hab | hab
  · subst hab
    rcases eq_or_ne c d with hcd | hcd
    · subst hcd; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl a), Lof, dif_pos (le_refl c)]; rfl
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hcd with hlt | hgt
      · rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl a), Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
      · rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl a), Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]; rfl
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hablt | habgt
    · rw [Lof, dif_pos hablt.le]
      rcases eq_or_ne c d with hcd | hcd
      · subst hcd; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl c)]; rfl
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hcd with hlt | hgt
        · rw [Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
        · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]; rfl
    · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr habgt)]
      rcases eq_or_ne c d with hcd | hcd
      · subst hcd; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl c)]; rfl
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hcd with hlt | hgt
        · rw [Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
        · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]; rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.G4_LL
statement:
theorem G4_LL (n : ℕ) (a b c d : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Lof a b) (Lof c d) = deltaFBasis n (fBetaN n) (Lof a b) (Lof c d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Lof]
  unfold deltaFBasis
  rw [fBetaN_Lof, bracketN_zero_left, fBetaN_Lof, bracketN_zero_right, smul_zero]
  rw [bracketN_eN_eN, bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof]
  unfold bracketLLn
  rw [fBetaN_add, fBetaN_add, fBetaN_add, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul,
      fBetaN_Lof, fBetaN_Lof, fBetaN_Lof, fBetaN_Lof]
  simp

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_smul_Lof
statement:
theorem sum_vN_smul_Lof (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * n)) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof a t) = -fBetaN n (eN (Fof a))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ t, (eN (Lof a t) : IndexedMod n) = eN (Lof t a) := by
    intro t; rw [Lof_comm]
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_alt_form]
  rw [neg_neg]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul
statement:
theorem sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul (n : ℕ) (s : Fin (2 * n)) (c : Pn n) (X : IndexedMod n) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • ((c * Jn n s t) • X) = (c * -betaN n s) • X
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∀ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • ((c * Jn n s t) • X) =
    (vN n t * (c * Jn n s t)) • X := by
    intro t; rw [smul_smul]
  simp_rw [step1]
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  calc ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * (c * Jn n s t)
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), c * (vN n t * Jn n s t) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _; ring
    _ = c * ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * Jn n s t := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = c * (-betaN n s) := by rw [contraction_identity_neg]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul'
statement:
theorem sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul' (n : ℕ) (s : Fin (2 * n)) (c : Pn n) (X : IndexedMod n) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • ((c * Jn n t s) • X) = (c * betaN n s) • X
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∀ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • ((c * Jn n t s) • X) =
    (vN n t * (c * Jn n t s)) • X := by
    intro t; rw [smul_smul]
  simp_rw [step1]
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  calc ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * (c * Jn n t s)
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), c * (vN n t * Jn n t s) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _; ring
    _ = c * ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t * Jn n t s := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = c * betaN n s := by rw [contraction_identity]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_const_smul_Lof
statement:
theorem sum_vN_const_smul_Lof (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * n)) (c : Pn n) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • (c • eN (Lof a t)) = c • (-fBetaN n (eN (Fof a)))
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∀ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • (c • eN (Lof a t)) = c • (vN n t • eN (Lof a t)) := by
    intro t; rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]; congr 1; ring
  simp_rw [step1]
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum, sum_vN_smul_Lof]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_const_smul_Lof'
statement:
theorem sum_vN_const_smul_Lof' (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * n)) (c : Pn n) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • (c • eN (Lof t a)) = c • (-fBetaN n (eN (Fof a)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ t : Fin (2 * n), (eN (Lof t a) : IndexedMod n) = eN (Lof a t) := by
    intro t; rw [Lof_comm]
  simp_rw [h1]
  exact sum_vN_const_smul_Lof n a c

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.sum_vN_const_smul_Fof
statement:
theorem sum_vN_const_smul_Fof (n : ℕ) (c : Pn n) :
    ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • (c • eN (Fof t)) = c • FVecBeta n
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∀ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • (c • eN (Fof t)) = c • (vN n t • eN (Fof t)) := by
    intro t; rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]; congr 1; ring
  simp_rw [step1]
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Fof
statement:
theorem GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Fof (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Lof u v) (Fof w) = gammaLFn n u v w
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne u v with heq | hne
  · subst heq; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl u)]; rfl
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · rw [Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
    · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]
      change gammaLFn n v u w = gammaLFn n u v w
      unfold gammaLFn; rw [add_comm]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.G4_LF
statement:
theorem G4_LF (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Lof u v) (Fof w) = deltaFBasis n (fBetaN n) (Lof u v) (Fof w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold deltaFBasis
  rw [fBetaN_Lof, bracketN_zero_left, zero_add, parity_Lof, gsignN_01, one_smul,
      GammaBetaBasis_Lof_Fof]
  rw [fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_alt_form, bracketN_neg_right]
  rw [show bracketN n (eN (Lof u v : IndexedBasis n)) (∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t w))
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • bracketBasisN n (Lof u v) (Lof t w) from by
    rw [bracketN_sum_right']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _
    rw [bracketN_smul_right, bracketN_eN_eN]]
  simp_rw [bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof]
  unfold bracketLLn
  simp_rw [smul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul n v (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Lof u w)),
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul n u (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Lof v w)),
      sum_vN_const_smul_Lof n u (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n v w),
      sum_vN_const_smul_Lof n v (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n u w)]
  rw [bracketN_eN_eN, bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof]
  unfold bracketLFn
  rw [fBetaN_add, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul]
  simp only [smul_neg, mul_neg]
  unfold gammaLFn
  simp only [neg_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
  ring_nf

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.G4_FF
statement:
theorem G4_FF (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Fof u) (Fof v) = deltaFBasis n (fBetaN n) (Fof u) (Fof v)
proof:
:= by
  change gammaFFn n u v = deltaFBasis n (fBetaN n) (Fof u) (Fof v)
  unfold deltaFBasis
  rw [parity_Fof, gsignN_11]
  rw [fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_alt_form, fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_alt_form]
  rw [bracketN_neg_left, bracketN_neg_right]
  rw [show bracketN n (∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t u)) (eN (Fof v))
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • bracketBasisN n (Lof t u) (Fof v) from by
    rw [bracketN_sum_left']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _
    rw [bracketN_smul_left, bracketN_eN_eN]]
  rw [show bracketN n (eN (Fof u : IndexedBasis n)) (∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t v))
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • bracketBasisN n (Fof u) (Lof t v) from by
    rw [bracketN_sum_right']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _
    rw [bracketN_smul_right, bracketN_eN_eN]]
  simp_rw [bracketBasisN_Lof_Fof, bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof]
  simp only [smul_neg, neg_neg, neg_smul, one_smul]
  unfold bracketLFn
  simp_rw [smul_add, neg_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      sum_vN_const_smul_Fof n (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n u v),
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul' n v (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Fof u)),
      sum_vN_const_smul_Fof n (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n v u),
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul' n u (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Fof v))]
  rw [bracketN_eN_eN, bracketBasisN_Fof_Fof]
  unfold bracketFFn
  rw [fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_Lof]
  rw [Jn_antisymm n u v]
  simp only [smul_zero, mul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg, sub_zero]
  unfold gammaFFn
  simp only [smul_add, smul_smul]
  ring_nf

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaBasis_Fof_Lof
statement:
theorem GammaBetaBasis_Fof_Lof (n : ℕ) (w u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Fof w) (Lof u v) = -gammaLFn n u v w
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne u v with heq | hne
  · subst heq; rw [Lof, dif_pos (le_refl u)]; rfl
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · rw [Lof, dif_pos hlt.le]; rfl
    · rw [Lof, dif_neg (not_le.mpr hgt)]
      change -gammaLFn n v u w = -gammaLFn n u v w
      unfold gammaLFn; rw [add_comm]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.G4_FL
statement:
theorem G4_FL (n : ℕ) (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    GammaBetaBasis n (Fof w) (Lof u v) = deltaFBasis n (fBetaN n) (Fof w) (Lof u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GammaBetaBasis_Fof_Lof]
  unfold deltaFBasis
  rw [fBetaN_Lof, bracketN_zero_right, smul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [fBetaN_eN, fBetaBasis_alt_form, bracketN_neg_left]
  rw [show bracketN n (∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • eN (Lof t w)) (eN (Lof u v))
      = ∑ t : Fin (2 * n), vN n t • bracketBasisN n (Lof t w) (Lof u v) from by
    rw [bracketN_sum_left']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t _
    rw [bracketN_smul_left, bracketN_eN_eN]]
  simp_rw [bracketBasisN_Lof_Lof]
  unfold bracketLLn
  simp_rw [smul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_vN_const_smul_Lof' n v (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n w u),
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul' n u (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Lof w v)),
      sum_vN_const_smul_Lof' n u (cratN n (1 / 2) * Jn n w v),
      sum_vN_mul_Jn_const_smul' n v (cratN n (1 / 2)) (eN (Lof w u))]
  rw [bracketN_eN_eN, bracketBasisN_Fof_Lof, fBetaN_neg]
  unfold bracketLFn
  rw [fBetaN_add, fBetaN_smul, fBetaN_smul]
  rw [Jn_antisymm n u w, Jn_antisymm n v w]
  simp only [smul_neg]
  unfold gammaLFn
  rw [show Lof v w = Lof w v from Lof_comm v w, show Lof u w = Lof w u from Lof_comm u w]
  simp only [neg_smul, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_neg]
  ring_nf

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.G4
statement:
theorem G4 (n : ℕ) (i j : IndexedBasis n) : GammaBetaBasis n i j = deltaFBasis n
  (fBetaN n) i j
proof:
:= by
  match i, j with
  | .inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩, .inl ⟨(c, d), h2⟩ =>
      have e1 : (Sum.inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩ : IndexedBasis n) = Lof a b := by rw [Lof, dif_pos h1]
      have e2 : (Sum.inl ⟨(c, d), h2⟩ : IndexedBasis n) = Lof c d := by rw [Lof, dif_pos h2]
      rw [e1, e2]; exact G4_LL n a b c d
  | .inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩, .inr w =>
      have e1 : (Sum.inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩ : IndexedBasis n) = Lof a b := by rw [Lof, dif_pos h1]
      rw [e1]; exact G4_LF n a b w
  | .inr w, .inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩ =>
      have e1 : (Sum.inl ⟨(a, b), h1⟩ : IndexedBasis n) = Lof a b := by rw [Lof, dif_pos h1]
      rw [e1]; exact G4_FL n a b w
  | .inr u, .inr v => exact G4_FF n u v

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaN_eq_deltaFN
statement:
theorem GammaBetaN_eq_deltaFN (n : ℕ) (x y : IndexedMod n) :
    GammaBetaN n x y = deltaFN n (fBetaN n) x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold GammaBetaN deltaFN bilinearExtend
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
  rw [G4 n i j]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Indexed.GammaBetaN_eq_deltaFN_homog
statement:
theorem GammaBetaN_eq_deltaFN_homog (n : ℕ) (x y : IndexedMod n) (dx dy : ZMod 2)
    (hx : IsHomogN x dx) (hy : IsHomogN y dy) :
    GammaBetaN n x y = deltaFN n (fBetaN n) x y
proof:
:=
  GammaBetaN_eq_deltaFN n x y

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappa_sq
statement: theorem kappa_sq (n : ℕ) : kappa n * kappa n = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold kappa
  rw [CliffordAlgebra.ι_sq_scalar]
  rw [show Qzero n 1 = 0 from rfl]
  exact map_zero _

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappa_mem_RGrading_one
statement: theorem kappa_mem_RGrading_one (n : ℕ) : kappa n ∈ RGrading n 1
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.ι_mem_evenOdd_one (Qzero n) 1

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappa_ne_zero
statement: theorem kappa_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : kappa n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set F : RRing n →ₐ[Indexed.Pn n] TrivSqZeroExt (Indexed.Pn n) (Indexed.Pn n) :=
    CliffordAlgebra.lift (Qzero n)
      ⟨TrivSqZeroExt.inrHom (Indexed.Pn n) (Indexed.Pn n), fun m => by
        rw [TrivSqZeroExt.inrHom, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, TrivSqZeroExt.inr_mul_inr,
          show Qzero n m = 0 from rfl, map_zero]⟩ with hF
  have hFkappa : F (kappa n) = TrivSqZeroExt.inr 1 := by
    rw [kappa, hF, CliffordAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, TrivSqZeroExt.inrHom, LinearMap.coe_mk,
      AddHom.coe_mk]
  intro h
  rw [h, map_zero] at hFkappa
  exact one_ne_zero (by
    have := congrArg TrivSqZeroExt.snd hFkappa.symm
    rwa [TrivSqZeroExt.snd_inr, TrivSqZeroExt.snd_zero] at this)

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.a_ne_zero
statement: theorem a_ne_zero : Source.a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial C := inferInstance
  intro h
  apply (one_ne_zero (α := C))
  have h2 := Source.a_sq
  rw [h, mul_zero] at h2
  have h3 := congrArg (fun x => (2 : ℚ) • x) h2
  simp only [smul_smul, smul_zero] at h3
  norm_num at h3

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ZMod2_eq_zero_or_one
statement: theorem ZMod2_eq_zero_or_one (i : ZMod 2) : i = 0 ∨ i = 1
proof: := by revert i; decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ZMod2_add_cases
statement:
theorem ZMod2_add_cases (i j : ZMod 2) :
    (i = 0 ∧ j = 0 ∧ i + j = 0) ∨ (i = 0 ∧ j = 1 ∧ i + j = 1) ∨
    (i = 1 ∧ j = 0 ∧ i + j = 1) ∨ (i = 1 ∧ j = 1 ∧ i + j = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ZMod2_eq_zero_or_one i with hi | hi <;> rcases ZMod2_eq_zero_or_one j with hj | hj <;>
    subst hi <;> subst hj <;>
    simp_all only [one_ne_zero, false_and, and_self, add_eq_left, and_false, true_and, false_or]
      <;> decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ZMod2_total_degree_cases
statement:
theorem ZMod2_total_degree_cases (i j : ZMod 2) :
    (i + j = (0 : ZMod 2) + 0 + (i + j)) ∧ (i + j = (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 + (i + (j + 1))) ∧
    (i + j = (1 : ZMod 2) + 0 + (i + 1 + j)) ∧ (i + j = (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 + (i + 1 + (j + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  revert i j; decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ZMod2_one_add_succ
statement: theorem ZMod2_one_add_succ (k : ZMod 2) : (1 : ZMod 2) + (k + 1) = k
proof: := by revert k; decide

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0GradingMap_tmul
statement:
theorem A0GradingMap_tmul (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (c : CGrading k) :
    A0GradingMap n k (w ⊗ₜ c) = w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C)
proof: := rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0Grading_mem_of_tmul
statement:
theorem A0Grading_mem_of_tmul (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (c : CGrading k) :
    w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C) ∈ A0Grading n k
proof:
:=
  ⟨w ⊗ₜ c, A0GradingMap_tmul n k w c⟩

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0_decompose_lin_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem A0_decompose_lin_tmul_coe (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
    (c : CGrading k) :
    A0_decompose_lin n (w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => A0Grading n k) k
        ⟨w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C), A0Grading_mem_of_tmul n k w c⟩
proof:
:= by
  change (DirectSum.lmap fun k => LinearMap.rangeRestrict (A0GradingMap n k))
      ((TensorProduct.directSumRight ℚ ℚ (Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (fun k => CGrading k))
        ((TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℚ (Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)))
          (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv CGrading)) (w ⊗ₜ (c : C)))) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    DirectSum.decompose_coe, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, TensorProduct.directSumRight_tmul_lof,
    DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A0_decompose_lin_tmul
statement:
theorem A0_decompose_lin_tmul (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
    (c : CGrading k) :
    A0_decompose_lin n (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C) : A0 n) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => A0Grading n k) k
        ⟨(w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C) : A0 n), A0Grading_mem_of_tmul n k w c⟩
proof:
:=
  A0_decompose_lin_tmul_coe n k w c

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ABGradingMap_tmul
statement:
theorem ABGradingMap_tmul (n : ℕ) (i j : ZMod 2) (r : RGradingQ n i) (x : A0Grading n j) :
    ABGradingMap n i j (r ⊗ₜ x) = (r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x : A0 n)
proof: := rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ABGradingMap_range_le
statement:
theorem ABGradingMap_range_le (n : ℕ) (i j : ZMod 2) :
    LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n i j) ≤ ABGrading n (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ZMod2_eq_zero_or_one i with hi | hi <;> subst hi
  · rw [zero_add]; exact le_sup_left
  · change LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n 1 j) ≤
      LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n 0 (1 + j)) ⊔ LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n 1 ((1 + j) + 1))
    rw [show (1 + j : ZMod 2) + 1 = j from by revert j; decide]
    exact le_sup_right

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ABGrading_mem_of_tmul
statement:
theorem ABGrading_mem_of_tmul (n : ℕ) (i j : ZMod 2) (r : RGradingQ n i) (x : A0Grading n j) :
    (r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x : A0 n) ∈ ABGrading n (i + j)
proof:
:=
  ABGradingMap_range_le n i j ⟨r ⊗ₜ x, rfl⟩

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.AB_decompose_lin_tmul
statement:
theorem AB_decompose_lin_tmul (n : ℕ) (i j : ZMod 2) (r : RGradingQ n i) (x : A0Grading n j) :
    AB_decompose_lin n ((r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x : A0 n)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => ABGrading n k) (i + j)
        ⟨(r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x : A0 n), ABGrading_mem_of_tmul n i j r x⟩
proof:
:= by
  change (DirectSum.toModule ℚ (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (⨁ k : ZMod 2, ABGrading n k)
      (fun p => (DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => ABGrading n k) (p.1 + p.2)).comp
        ((Submodule.inclusion (ABGradingMap_range_le n p.1 p.2)).comp
          (LinearMap.rangeRestrict (ABGradingMap n p.1 p.2)))))
      ((TensorProduct.directSum ℚ ℚ (fun i => RGradingQ n i) (fun j => A0Grading n j))
        ((TensorProduct.congr (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv (RGradingQ n))
          (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv (A0Grading n))) (r ⊗ₜ x))) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.congr_tmul, DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply, DirectSum.decompose_coe, DirectSum.decompose_coe,
    ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, TensorProduct.directSum_lof_tmul_lof,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.DirectSum_lof_ABGrading_congr
statement:
theorem DirectSum_lof_ABGrading_congr (n : ℕ) {i i' : ZMod 2} (h : i = i') (v : AB n)
    (hi : v ∈ ABGrading n i) (hi' : v ∈ ABGrading n i') :
    DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => ABGrading n k) i ⟨v, hi⟩ =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ (ZMod 2) (fun k => ABGrading n k) i' ⟨v, hi'⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ABGradingMap0_range_le
statement:
theorem ABGradingMap0_range_le (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) :
    LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n 0 k) ≤ ABGrading n k
proof:
:= by
  have h := ABGradingMap_range_le n 0 k; rwa [zero_add] at h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.ABGradingMap1_range_le
statement:
theorem ABGradingMap1_range_le (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) :
    LinearMap.range (ABGradingMap n 1 (k + 1)) ≤ ABGrading n k
proof:
:= by
  have h := ABGradingMap_range_le n 1 (k + 1); rwa [ZMod2_one_add_succ] at h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.aA0_mem_A0Grading_one
statement: theorem aA0_mem_A0Grading_one (n : ℕ) : aA0 n ∈ A0Grading n 1
proof:
:=
  A0Grading_mem_of_tmul n 1 1 (⟨Source.a, Source.a_odd⟩ : CGrading 1)

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.aA0_ne_zero
statement: theorem aA0_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : aA0 n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ
    (one_ne_zero (α := Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)))
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ Source.a_ne_zero
  have hΦ : ((TensorProduct.lid ℚ ℚ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map f g)
      ((1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Source.a : C)) = 1 := by
    simp [TensorProduct.map_tmul, hf, hg]
  rw [show ((1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Source.a : C) : A0 n) = aA0 n from rfl, h] at hΦ
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hΦ
  exact one_ne_zero hΦ.symm

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.kappa_mem_RGradingQ_one
statement: theorem kappa_mem_RGradingQ_one (n : ℕ) : kappa n ∈ RGradingQ n 1
proof:
:=
  kappa_mem_RGrading_one n

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A3_independence
statement:
theorem A3_independence (n : ℕ) :
    kappaAB n * aAB n = -(aAB n * kappaAB n) ∧ kappaAB n * aAB n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : kappaAB n * aAB n = (kappa n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (aA0 n) := by
    unfold kappaAB aAB
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
      (kappa n) (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (A0Grading n)⟩ : A0Grading n 0)
      (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (RGradingQ n)⟩ : RGradingQ n 0) (aA0 n)]
    rw [mul_one, one_mul]
  have e2 : aAB n * kappaAB n =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ ((1 : ZMod 2) * (1 : ZMod 2)) •
        ((kappa n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (aA0 n) : AB n) := by
    unfold kappaAB aAB
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul (𝒜 := RGradingQ n) (ℬ := A0Grading n)
      (1 : RRing n) (⟨aA0 n, aA0_mem_A0Grading_one n⟩ : A0Grading n 1)
      (⟨kappa n, kappa_mem_RGradingQ_one n⟩ : RGradingQ n 1) (1 : A0 n)]
    congr 2
    · exact one_mul (kappa n)
    · exact mul_one (aA0 n)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e1, e2]
    norm_num
  · rw [e1]
    intro h
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ (kappa_ne_zero n)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ (aA0_ne_zero n)
    have hΦ : ((TensorProduct.lid ℚ ℚ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map f g)
        ((kappa n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (aA0 n)) = 1 := by
      simp [TensorProduct.map_tmul, hf, hg]
    rw [show ((kappa n) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (aA0 n) : AB n) =
      ((kappa n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (aA0 n) : AB n) from rfl, h] at hΦ
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hΦ
    exact one_ne_zero hΦ.symm

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A4_W_into_A0
statement:
theorem A4_W_into_A0 (n : ℕ) (w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) :
    (w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C) : A0 n) ∈ A0Grading n 0
proof:
:=
  A0Grading_mem_of_tmul n 0 w (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded CGrading⟩ : CGrading 0)

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A4_C_into_A0
statement:
theorem A4_C_into_A0 (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (c : CGrading k) :
    ((1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (c : C) : A0 n) ∈ A0Grading n k
proof:
:=
  A0Grading_mem_of_tmul n k 1 c

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A4_R_into_AB
statement:
theorem A4_R_into_AB (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (r : RGradingQ n k) :
    ((r : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : A0 n) : AB n) ∈ ABGrading n k
proof:
:= by
  have h := ABGrading_mem_of_tmul n k 0 r
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (A0Grading n)⟩ : A0Grading n 0)
  rwa [add_zero] at h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.A4_A0_into_AB
statement:
theorem A4_A0_into_AB (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod 2) (x : A0Grading n k) :
    ((1 : RRing n) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (x : A0 n) : AB n) ∈ ABGrading n k
proof:
:= by
  have h := ABGrading_mem_of_tmul n 0 k
    (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded (RGradingQ n)⟩ : RGradingQ n 0) x
  rwa [zero_add] at h

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.comm_mul_right
statement:
theorem comm_mul_right (x y z : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) :
    x*(y*z) - (y*z)*x = (x*y-y*x)*z + y*(x*z-z*x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.comm_mul_left
statement:
theorem comm_mul_left (x y z : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) :
    (x*y)*z - z*(x*y) = x*(y*z-z*y) + (x*z-z*x)*y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  abel

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.comm_scalar
statement:
theorem comm_scalar (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    B n u * B n v - B n v * B n u = JnQ n u v • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
proof: := B_comm n u v

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.symm_comm_symm
statement:
theorem symm_comm_symm (a b c d : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (p q r s : ℚ)
    (hac : a * c - c * a = p • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)))
    (had : a * d - d * a = q • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)))
    (hbc : b * c - c * b = r • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)))
    (hbd : b * d - d * b = s • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))) :
    (a*b+b*a)*(c*d+d*c) - (c*d+d*c)*(a*b+b*a)
      = (2:ℚ) • (r • (a*d+d*a) + s • (a*c+c*a) + p • (b*d+d*b) + q • (b*c+c*b))
proof:
:= by
  have hab_cd : a*b*(c*d) - (c*d)*(a*b) = a*(b*(c*d)-(c*d)*b) + (a*(c*d)-(c*d)*a)*b :=
      comm_mul_left n a b (c*d)
  have hbcd : b*(c*d) - (c*d)*b = (b*c-c*b)*d + c*(b*d-d*b) := comm_mul_right n b c d
  have hacd : a*(c*d) - (c*d)*a = (a*c-c*a)*d + c*(a*d-d*a) := comm_mul_right n a c d
  have hba_cd : b*a*(c*d) - (c*d)*(b*a) = b*(a*(c*d)-(c*d)*a) + (b*(c*d)-(c*d)*b)*a :=
      comm_mul_left n b a (c*d)
  have hab_dc : a*b*(d*c) - (d*c)*(a*b) = a*(b*(d*c)-(d*c)*b) + (a*(d*c)-(d*c)*a)*b :=
      comm_mul_left n a b (d*c)
  have hbdc : b*(d*c) - (d*c)*b = (b*d-d*b)*c + d*(b*c-c*b) := comm_mul_right n b d c
  have hadc : a*(d*c) - (d*c)*a = (a*d-d*a)*c + d*(a*c-c*a) := comm_mul_right n a d c
  have hba_dc : b*a*(d*c) - (d*c)*(b*a) = b*(a*(d*c)-(d*c)*a) + (b*(d*c)-(d*c)*b)*a :=
      comm_mul_left n b a (d*c)
  have key : (a*b+b*a)*(c*d+d*c) - (c*d+d*c)*(a*b+b*a)
      = (a*b*(c*d) - (c*d)*(a*b)) + (a*b*(d*c) - (d*c)*(a*b))
        + (b*a*(c*d) - (c*d)*(b*a)) + (b*a*(d*c) - (d*c)*(b*a)) := by
    noncomm_ring
  rw [key, hab_cd, hab_dc, hba_cd, hba_dc, hacd, hbcd, hadc, hbdc, hac, had, hbc, hbd]
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul, mul_one]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0hat_comm
statement:
theorem L0hat_comm (u v w z : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0hat n u v * L0hat n w z - L0hat n w z * L0hat n u v
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • L0hat n u z + JnQ n u w • L0hat n v z
          + JnQ n v z • L0hat n u w + JnQ n u z • L0hat n v w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold L0hat
  rw [show (1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) * ((1/4:ℚ) • (B n w * B n z + B n z * B n w))
        - (1/4:ℚ) • (B n w * B n z + B n z * B n w) * ((1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u))
      = (1/16 : ℚ) • ((B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) * (B n w * B n z + B n z * B n w)
          - (B n w * B n z + B n z * B n w) * (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u)) from by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm]; module]
  rw [symm_comm_symm n (B n u) (B n v) (B n w) (B n z) (JnQ n u w) (JnQ n u z) (JnQ n v w)
    (JnQ n v z)
    (comm_scalar n u w) (comm_scalar n u z) (comm_scalar n v w) (comm_scalar n v z)]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.Bu0_mul'
statement:
theorem Bu0_mul' (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    Bu0 n u * Bu0 n v = (B n u * B n v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Bu0
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
    (B n u) (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded CGrading⟩ : CGrading 0) (⟨B n v, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0)
    (1 : C)]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0_eq_tmul
statement:
theorem L0_eq_tmul (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0 n u v = (L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)
proof:
:= by
  unfold L0 L0hat
  rw [Bu0_mul', Bu0_mul']
  change (1/4:ℚ) • (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        ((B n u * B n v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C))
      + GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        ((B n v * B n u : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)))
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        (((1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C))
  rw [← map_add, ← TensorProduct.add_tmul, ← map_smul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0_comm_F0
statement:
theorem L0_comm_F0 (u v w : Fin (2 * n)) :
    L0 n u v * F0 n w - F0 n w * L0 n u v
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • F0 n u + JnQ n u w • F0 n v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold F0
  rw [L0_eq_tmul]
  rw [show (L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)) * ((1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n w))
        - (1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n w) * (L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = (1/2:ℚ) • (L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C) * (aA0 n * Bu0 n w)
          - (aA0 n * Bu0 n w) * (L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))) from by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]; module]
  have step1 : L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C) * (aA0 n * Bu0 n w)
      = aA0 n * ((L0hat n u v * B n w) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)) := by
    unfold aA0 Bu0
    rw [show ((L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
          * ((1:Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Source.a:C) * (B n w) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
        = ((L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
          * (((1:Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) * B n w) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (Source.a * 1 : C)) from by
      rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
        (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (⟨Source.a, Source.a_odd⟩ : CGrading 1)
        (⟨B n w, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (1 : C)]]
    rw [one_mul, mul_one]
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
      (L0hat n u v) (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded CGrading⟩ : CGrading 0)
      (⟨B n w, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (Source.a : C)]
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
      (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) (⟨Source.a, Source.a_odd⟩ : CGrading 1)
      (⟨L0hat n u v * B n w, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (1 : C)]
    simp
  have step2 : (aA0 n * Bu0 n w) * (L0hat n u v ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = aA0 n * ((B n w * L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)) := by
    unfold aA0 Bu0
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
      (B n w) (⟨1, SetLike.one_mem_graded CGrading⟩ : CGrading 0)
      (⟨L0hat n u v, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (1 : C)]
    simp
  rw [step1, step2, ← mul_sub]
  rw [show ((L0hat n u v * B n w) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)) - ((B n w * L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = (L0hat n u v * B n w - B n w * L0hat n u v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C) from by
    change (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
          ((L0hat n u v * B n w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)))
        - GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
          ((B n w * L0hat n u v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
          ((L0hat n u v * B n w - B n w * L0hat n u v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
    rw [← map_sub, TensorProduct.sub_tmul]]
  have hcomm : L0hat n u v * B n w - B n w * L0hat n u v
      = (1/2 : ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • B n u + JnQ n u w • B n v) := by
    unfold L0hat
    rw [show (1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) * B n w
          - B n w * ((1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u))
        = (1/4:ℚ) • ((B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) * B n w
            - B n w * (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u)) from by
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]; module]
    have e1 : (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) * B n w - B n w * (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u)
        = (B n u * B n v * B n w - B n w * (B n u * B n v))
          + (B n v * B n u * B n w - B n w * (B n v * B n u)) := by noncomm_ring
    have e2 : B n u * B n v * B n w - B n w * (B n u * B n v)
        = B n u * (B n v * B n w - B n w * B n v) + (B n u * B n w - B n w * B n u) * B n v :=
      comm_mul_left n (B n u) (B n v) (B n w)
    have e3 : B n v * B n u * B n w - B n w * (B n v * B n u)
        = B n v * (B n u * B n w - B n w * B n u) + (B n v * B n w - B n w * B n v) * B n u :=
      comm_mul_left n (B n v) (B n u) (B n w)
    rw [e1, e2, e3, comm_scalar n u w, comm_scalar n v w]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul, mul_one]
    module
  rw [hcomm]
  rw [show (((1/2:ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • B n u + JnQ n u w • B n v) : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
      ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = (1/2:ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • Bu0 n u + JnQ n u w • Bu0 n v) from by
    unfold Bu0
    change GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        (((1/2:ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • B n u + JnQ n u w • B n v) : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      = (1/2:ℚ) • (JnQ n v w • GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
          ((B n u : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
        + JnQ n u w • GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
          ((B n v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)))
    rw [← map_smul, ← map_smul, ← map_add, ← map_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.add_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
      ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']]
  rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_add, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.Bu0_mul_L0hat_shape
statement:
theorem Bu0_mul_L0hat_shape (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    Bu0 n u * Bu0 n v + Bu0 n v * Bu0 n u = (4:ℚ) • L0 n u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [L0_eq_tmul]
  unfold L0hat
  rw [Bu0_mul', Bu0_mul']
  change ((B n u * B n v : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
      + ((B n v * B n u : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C))
    = (4:ℚ) • (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading
        (((1/4:ℚ) • (B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u) : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1:C)))
  rw [← map_smul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_smul]
  norm_num
  rw [← map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.F0_comm_F0
statement:
theorem F0_comm_F0 (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    F0 n u * F0 n v + F0 n v * F0 n u = (1/2 : ℚ) • L0 n u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold F0
  rw [show ((1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n u)) * ((1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n v))
        + ((1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n v)) * ((1/2:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n u))
      = (1/4:ℚ) • (aA0 n * Bu0 n u * (aA0 n * Bu0 n v)
          + aA0 n * Bu0 n v * (aA0 n * Bu0 n u)) from by
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm]; module]
  have e1 : aA0 n * Bu0 n u * (aA0 n * Bu0 n v) = (1/2:ℚ) • (Bu0 n u * Bu0 n v) := by
    rw [show aA0 n * Bu0 n u * (aA0 n * Bu0 n v) = Bu0 n u * (aA0 n * aA0 n) * Bu0 n v from by
      rw [a_comm_Bu0]; noncomm_ring]
    rw [aA0_sq, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc]
  have e2 : aA0 n * Bu0 n v * (aA0 n * Bu0 n u) = (1/2:ℚ) • (Bu0 n v * Bu0 n u) := by
    rw [show aA0 n * Bu0 n v * (aA0 n * Bu0 n u) = Bu0 n v * (aA0 n * aA0 n) * Bu0 n u from by
      rw [a_comm_Bu0]; noncomm_ring]
    rw [aA0_sq, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [e1, e2, ← smul_add, Bu0_mul_L0hat_shape]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  norm_num

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.Bu0_mul
statement:
theorem Bu0_mul (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    Bu0 n u * Bu0 n v = (B n u * B n v) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Bu0
  exact GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul (𝒜 := WGrading n) (ℬ := CGrading)
    (B n u) (⟨B n v, trivial⟩ : WGrading n 0) (1 : C)

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.B_mul_add_B_mul_swap
statement:
theorem B_mul_add_B_mul_swap (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    B n u * B n v + B n v * B n u
      = (2 : ℚ) • (B n v * B n u) + JnQ n u v • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))
proof:
:= by
  have h : B n u * B n v = B n v * B n u + JnQ n u v • (1 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) := by
    have := B_comm n u v
    unfold opComm at this
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at this
    rw [this]
    abel
  rw [h]
  module

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.L0FamilyIndependent_of_weyl
statement:
theorem L0FamilyIndependent_of_weyl (n : ℕ)
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ
      (fun p : {p : Fin (2 * n) × Fin (2 * n) // p.1 ≤ p.2} =>
        B n p.1.1 * B n p.1.2 + B n p.1.2 * B n p.1.1)) :
    L0FamilyIndependent n
proof:
:= by
  rw [L0FamilyIndependent, Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg p
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one ℚ (one_ne_zero (α := C))
  set Ψ : A0 n →ₗ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (WPoly n) :=
    (TensorProduct.rid ℚ (Module.End ℚ (WPoly n))).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n) →ₗ[ℚ] _) φ) ∘ₗ
      (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading).symm.toLinearMap with hΨdef
  have hΨw : ∀ w : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n), Ψ (w ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : C)) = w := by
    intro w
    change Ψ (GradedTensorProduct.of ℚ (WGrading n) CGrading (w ⊗ₜ (1 : C))) = w
    rw [hΨdef]
    simp [TensorProduct.map_tmul, hφ]
  have hΨL0 : ∀ q : {p : Fin (2 * n) × Fin (2 * n) // p.1 ≤ p.2},
      Ψ (L0 n q.1.1 q.1.2) = (1 / 4 : ℚ) • (B n q.1.1 * B n q.1.2 + B n q.1.2 * B n q.1.1) := by
    intro q
    unfold L0
    rw [map_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [map_add, Bu0_mul, Bu0_mul, hΨw, hΨw]
  have key : ∑ q, g q • Ψ (L0 n q.1.1 q.1.2) =
      ∑ q, g q • ((1 / 4 : ℚ) • (B n q.1.1 * B n q.1.2 + B n q.1.2 * B n q.1.1)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => by rw [hΨL0])
  simp only [← map_smul, ← map_sum] at key
  rw [hg, map_zero] at key
  have key2 : ∑ q, g q • (B n q.1.1 * B n q.1.2 + B n q.1.2 * B n q.1.1) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (0 : Module.End ℚ (WPoly n)) =
        (1 / 4 : ℚ) • ∑ q, g q • (B n q.1.1 * B n q.1.2 + B n q.1.2 * B n q.1.1) := by
      rw [key, Finset.smul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => smul_comm (g q) (1 / 4 : ℚ) _)
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm with h2 | h2
    · norm_num at h2
    · exact h2
  exact (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp h) g key2 p

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.oddIdx_le_oddIdx
statement:
theorem oddIdx_le_oddIdx (n : ℕ) (k l : Fin n) (h : k ≤ l) :
    Indexed.oddIdx n k ≤ Indexed.oddIdx n l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.le_def, Indexed.oddIdx] at h ⊢
  omega

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.evenIdx_le_evenIdx
statement:
theorem evenIdx_le_evenIdx (n : ℕ) (k l : Fin n) (h : k ≤ l) :
    Indexed.evenIdx n k ≤ Indexed.evenIdx n l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.le_def, Indexed.evenIdx] at h ⊢
  omega

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.evenIdx_le_oddIdx
statement:
theorem evenIdx_le_oddIdx (n : ℕ) (k l : Fin n) (h : k ≤ l) :
    Indexed.evenIdx n k ≤ Indexed.oddIdx n l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.le_def, Indexed.evenIdx, Indexed.oddIdx] at h ⊢
  omega

name: InhomogeneousDeformations.Source.oddIdx_le_evenIdx_of_lt
statement:
theorem oddIdx_le_evenIdx_of_lt (n : ℕ) (k l : Fin n) (h : k < l) :
